<h1 class="title">RFSI versus non-spatial Random Forest for Meuse zinc</h1>
</div>

<section id="a-leakage-safe-5-fold-cross-validation-workflow-in-python" class="level2">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="a-leakage-safe-5-fold-cross-validation-workflow-in-python">A leakage-safe 5-fold cross-validation workflow (in Python)</h2>
<section id="by-olha-kachalova" class="level4">
<h4 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="by-olha-kachalova"><em>by Olha Kachalova</em></h4>
</section>
<section id="research-questions" class="level3">
<h3 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="research-questions">Research questions:</h3>
<ol type="1">
<li>Is zinc prediction more accurate when Random Forest Spatial Interpolation (RFSI) is used instead of a Random Forest (RF) that ignores sample locations?</li>
<li>Does adding flood-related and soil covariates change the result?</li>
</ol>
</section>
<section id="what-this-workflow-does" class="level3">
<h3 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="what-this-workflow-does">What this workflow does:</h3>
<ol type="1">
<li>comparing RF and RFSI on exactly the same five folds;</li>
<li>repeating the comparison under four matched covariate scenarios;</li>
<li>constructing nearest-observation features separately inside every fold, preventing target leakage;</li>
<li>reporting RMSE, MAE, <span class="math inline">\(R^2\)</span>, mean error and Lin’s concordance correlation coefficient (CCC);</li>
<li>evaluating the <em>paired</em> difference between methods, rather than comparing two unrelated scores;</li>
<li>fitting both methods to all observations and mapping zinc over <code>meuse.grid</code>.</li>
<li>Optional sensitivity analyses:
<ul>
<li>to the number of neighbours;</li>
<li>repeated 5-fold;</li>
<li>log-transformation of zink values</li>
</ul></li>
</ol>
</section>
<section id="main-references" class="level3">
<h3 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="main-references">Main references</h3>
<ul>
<li>Sekulić, A. et al.&nbsp;(2020), <a href="https://doi.org/10.3390/rs12101687">Random Forest Spatial Interpolation</a>, <em>Remote Sensing</em>, 12, 1687.</li>
<li>OpenGeoHub, <a href="https://opengeohub.github.io/spatial-prediction-eml/spatial-interpolation-using-ensemble-ml.html#spatial-interpolation-using-ml-and-geographical-distances-to-neighbors">Spatial interpolation using ML and geographical distances to neighbours</a>.</li>
<li>OpenGeoHub, <a href="https://opengeohub.github.io/spatial-prediction-eml/">Spatial and spatiotemporal interpolation using Ensemble Machine Learning</a>.</li>
<li><code>sp</code> documentation for the <a href="https://edzer.github.io/sp/reference/meuse.html">Meuse observations</a> and <a href="https://edzer.github.io/sp/reference/meuse.grid.html">Meuse prediction grid</a>.</li>
</ul>
</section>
</section>
<section id="some-theory" class="level2">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="some-theory">1. Some theory</h2>
<p>Let <span class="math inline">\(z(s)\)</span> be zinc at location <span class="math inline">\(s\)</span>, and let <span class="math inline">\(c(s)\)</span> contain environmental covariates.</p>
<section id="rf-that-ignores-locations" class="level3">
<h3 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="rf-that-ignores-locations">RF that ignores locations</h3>
<p>The non-spatial model is</p>
<p><span class="math display">\[\hat z(s_0)=f_{RF}\{c(s_0)\}.\]</span></p>
<p>Coordinates <code>x</code> and <code>y</code>, distances to sample points, and neighbouring zinc observations are deliberately excluded. The model can still reproduce spatial patterns <em>indirectly</em> when environmental covariates themselves are spatially structured. Here, <code>dist</code> means distance to the Meuse river; it is an environmental covariate, not the location coordinates.</p>
</section>
<section id="rfsi" class="level3">
<h3 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="rfsi">RFSI</h3>
<p>RFSI augments the same environmental covariates with the values and distances of the <span class="math inline">\(k\)</span> nearest observed samples:</p>
<p><span class="math display">\[\hat z(s_0)=f_{RF}\{c(s_0),z(s_{(1)}),\ldots,z(s_{(k)}),d_{(1)},\ldots,d_{(k)}\}.\]</span></p>
<p>The neighbours are ordered by distance from the prediction location. RFSI is therefore similar in spirit to kriging or IDW because nearby measured responses directly inform a prediction, but RF learns a nonlinear, non-parametric combination instead of imposing a variogram and a linear weighted average.</p>
</section>
</section>
<section id="setting-up-the-software" class="level2">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="setting-up-the-software">2. Setting Up the Software</h2>
<p>Python libraries needed: <code>numpy</code> <code>pandas</code> <code>scipy</code> <code>scikit-learn</code> <code>matplotlib</code> <code>seaborn</code> <code>pyreadr</code></p>

<section id="meuse-dataset-owerview-data-integrity-checks-and-explanatory-analysis" class="level2">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="meuse-dataset-owerview-data-integrity-checks-and-explanatory-analysis">3. Meuse dataset: owerview, data integrity checks and explanatory analysis</h2>
<p>The observation table has 155 topsoil samples. Zinc is measured in mg kg<span class="math inline">\(^{-1}\)</span> soil. Coordinates use the Dutch RD New projected coordinate system (EPSG:28992), so Euclidean neighbour distances are in metres, which is necessary.</p>
<div id="5d28d75f" class="cell" data-execution_count="2">
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode cell-code" id="cb3"><pre class="sourceCode python code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode python"><span id="cb3-1"><a href="#cb3-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>DATA_DIR <span class="op">=</span> Path(<span class="st">"data"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb3-2"><a href="#cb3-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>DATA_DIR.mkdir(exist_ok<span class="op">=</span><span class="va">True</span>)</span>
<span id="cb3-3"><a href="#cb3-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb3-4"><a href="#cb3-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>BASE_URL <span class="op">=</span> <span class="st">"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/edzer/sp/master/data"</span></span>
<span id="cb3-5"><a href="#cb3-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb3-6"><a href="#cb3-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb3-7"><a href="#cb3-7" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="kw">def</span> load_rda(name):</span>
<span id="cb3-8"><a href="#cb3-8" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    path <span class="op">=</span> DATA_DIR <span class="op">/</span> <span class="ss">f"</span><span class="sc">{</span>name<span class="sc">}</span><span class="ss">.rda"</span></span>
<span id="cb3-9"><a href="#cb3-9" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="cf">if</span> <span class="kw">not</span> path.exists():</span>
<span id="cb3-10"><a href="#cb3-10" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        <span class="bu">print</span>(<span class="ss">f"Downloading </span><span class="sc">{</span>name<span class="sc">}</span><span class="ss">.rda ..."</span>)</span>
<span id="cb3-11"><a href="#cb3-11" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        urlretrieve(<span class="ss">f"</span><span class="sc">{</span>BASE_URL<span class="sc">}</span><span class="ss">/</span><span class="sc">{</span>name<span class="sc">}</span><span class="ss">.rda"</span>, path)</span>
<span id="cb3-12"><a href="#cb3-12" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    result <span class="op">=</span> pyreadr.read_r(<span class="bu">str</span>(path))</span>
<span id="cb3-13"><a href="#cb3-13" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="cf">return</span> result[name].reset_index(drop<span class="op">=</span><span class="va">True</span>)</span>
<span id="cb3-14"><a href="#cb3-14" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb3-15"><a href="#cb3-15" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb3-16"><a href="#cb3-16" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>meuse <span class="op">=</span> load_rda(<span class="st">"meuse"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb3-17"><a href="#cb3-17" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>grid <span class="op">=</span> load_rda(<span class="st">"meuse.grid"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb3-18"><a href="#cb3-18" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb3-19"><a href="#cb3-19" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># Force categorical variables to ordinary strings. This avoids accidentally</span></span>
<span id="cb3-20"><a href="#cb3-20" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># treating class codes as continuous quantities.</span></span>
<span id="cb3-21"><a href="#cb3-21" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">for</span> col <span class="kw">in</span> [<span class="st">"ffreq"</span>, <span class="st">"soil"</span>, <span class="st">"lime"</span>, <span class="st">"landuse"</span>]:</span>
<span id="cb3-22"><a href="#cb3-22" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="cf">if</span> col <span class="kw">in</span> meuse:</span>
<span id="cb3-23"><a href="#cb3-23" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        meuse[col] <span class="op">=</span> meuse[col].astype(<span class="bu">object</span>).where(meuse[col].notna(), <span class="st">"Missing"</span>).astype(<span class="bu">str</span>)</span>
<span id="cb3-24"><a href="#cb3-24" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">for</span> col <span class="kw">in</span> [<span class="st">"ffreq"</span>, <span class="st">"soil"</span>]:</span>
<span id="cb3-25"><a href="#cb3-25" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    grid[col] <span class="op">=</span> grid[col].astype(<span class="bu">object</span>).where(grid[col].notna(), <span class="st">"Missing"</span>).astype(<span class="bu">str</span>)</span>
<span id="cb3-26"><a href="#cb3-26" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb3-27"><a href="#cb3-27" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="bu">print</span>(<span class="st">"Observations:"</span>, meuse.shape)</span>
<span id="cb3-28"><a href="#cb3-28" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="bu">print</span>(<span class="st">"Prediction grid:"</span>, grid.shape)</span>
<span id="cb3-29"><a href="#cb3-29" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb3-30"><a href="#cb3-30" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>display(meuse.head())</span>
<span id="cb3-31"><a href="#cb3-31" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>display(grid.head())</span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>

<section id="data-integrity-checks" class="level3">
<h3 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="data-integrity-checks">Data integrity checks</h3>
<p>RFSI training features exclude each sample from its own neighbour list. This is easiest and safest when sample coordinates are unique. The checks below fail early if the target or coordinates are missing, the CRS-like coordinate scale is implausible, or duplicated locations occur.</p>
<div id="0ccbc4d1" class="cell" data-execution_count="3">
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode cell-code" id="cb5"><pre class="sourceCode python code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode python"><span id="cb5-1"><a href="#cb5-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>required_obs <span class="op">=</span> {<span class="st">"x"</span>, <span class="st">"y"</span>, <span class="st">"zinc"</span>, <span class="st">"dist"</span>, <span class="st">"ffreq"</span>, <span class="st">"soil"</span>}</span>
<span id="cb5-2"><a href="#cb5-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>required_grid <span class="op">=</span> {<span class="st">"x"</span>, <span class="st">"y"</span>, <span class="st">"dist"</span>, <span class="st">"ffreq"</span>, <span class="st">"soil"</span>}</span>
<span id="cb5-3"><a href="#cb5-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb5-4"><a href="#cb5-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">assert</span> required_obs.issubset(meuse.columns)</span>
<span id="cb5-5"><a href="#cb5-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">assert</span> required_grid.issubset(grid.columns)</span>
<span id="cb5-6"><a href="#cb5-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">assert</span> meuse[[<span class="st">"x"</span>, <span class="st">"y"</span>, <span class="st">"zinc"</span>, <span class="st">"dist"</span>, <span class="st">"ffreq"</span>, <span class="st">"soil"</span>]].notna().<span class="bu">all</span>().<span class="bu">all</span>()</span>
<span id="cb5-7"><a href="#cb5-7" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">assert</span> grid[[<span class="st">"x"</span>, <span class="st">"y"</span>, <span class="st">"dist"</span>, <span class="st">"ffreq"</span>, <span class="st">"soil"</span>]].notna().<span class="bu">all</span>().<span class="bu">all</span>()</span>
<span id="cb5-8"><a href="#cb5-8" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">assert</span> <span class="kw">not</span> meuse.duplicated([<span class="st">"x"</span>, <span class="st">"y"</span>]).<span class="bu">any</span>(), <span class="st">"Duplicate coordinates need explicit handling."</span></span>
<span id="cb5-9"><a href="#cb5-9" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">assert</span> meuse[<span class="st">"x"</span>].median() <span class="op">&gt;</span> <span class="dv">100_000</span>, <span class="st">"Coordinates do not look like projected RD New metres."</span></span>
<span id="cb5-10"><a href="#cb5-10" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">assert</span> <span class="bu">len</span>(meuse) <span class="op">==</span> <span class="dv">155</span></span>
<span id="cb5-11"><a href="#cb5-11" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb5-12"><a href="#cb5-12" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="bu">print</span>(meuse[<span class="st">"zinc"</span>].describe())</span>
<span id="cb5-13"><a href="#cb5-13" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="bu">print</span>(<span class="st">"Zinc skewness:"</span>, <span class="bu">round</span>(skew(meuse[<span class="st">"zinc"</span>], bias<span class="op">=</span><span class="va">False</span>), <span class="dv">3</span>))</span>
<span id="cb5-14"><a href="#cb5-14" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="bu">print</span>(<span class="st">"Flood-frequency counts:</span><span class="ch">\n</span><span class="st">"</span>, meuse[<span class="st">"ffreq"</span>].value_counts().sort_index())</span>
<span id="cb5-15"><a href="#cb5-15" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="bu">print</span>(<span class="st">"Soil-type counts:</span><span class="ch">\n</span><span class="st">"</span>, meuse[<span class="st">"soil"</span>].value_counts().sort_index())</span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>

<section id="exploratory-analysis" class="level3">
<h3 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="exploratory-analysis">Exploratory analysis</h3>
<p>Zinc is strongly right-skewed, and high concentrations occur mainly near the river. This matters because RMSE heavily penalizes large errors at high-zinc observations, while MAE describes typical absolute error more robustly. We therefore report both. <strong>Raw zinc is considered the primary target</strong> so results are directly interpretable in mg kg<span class="math inline">\(^{-1}\)</span>; a <strong>log-target sensitivity analysis</strong> is offered later in addons.</p>
<div id="d67ccd06" class="cell" data-execution_count="4">
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode cell-code" id="cb7"><pre class="sourceCode python code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode python"><span id="cb7-1"><a href="#cb7-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>fig, axes <span class="op">=</span> plt.subplots(<span class="dv">1</span>, <span class="dv">3</span>, figsize<span class="op">=</span>(<span class="dv">16</span>, <span class="fl">4.5</span>))</span>
<span id="cb7-2"><a href="#cb7-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb7-3"><a href="#cb7-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>sns.histplot(meuse[<span class="st">"zinc"</span>], bins<span class="op">=</span><span class="dv">25</span>, kde<span class="op">=</span><span class="va">True</span>, ax<span class="op">=</span>axes[<span class="dv">0</span>], color<span class="op">=</span><span class="st">"#8c2d04"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb7-4"><a href="#cb7-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>axes[<span class="dv">0</span>].set_title(<span class="st">"Raw zinc"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb7-5"><a href="#cb7-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>axes[<span class="dv">0</span>].set_xlabel(<span class="st">"Zinc (mg kg$^{-1}$)"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb7-6"><a href="#cb7-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb7-7"><a href="#cb7-7" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>sns.histplot(np.log1p(meuse[<span class="st">"zinc"</span>]), bins<span class="op">=</span><span class="dv">25</span>, kde<span class="op">=</span><span class="va">True</span>, ax<span class="op">=</span>axes[<span class="dv">1</span>], color<span class="op">=</span><span class="st">"#2b8cbe"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb7-8"><a href="#cb7-8" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>axes[<span class="dv">1</span>].set_title(<span class="st">"log(1 + zinc)"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb7-9"><a href="#cb7-9" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb7-10"><a href="#cb7-10" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>sc <span class="op">=</span> axes[<span class="dv">2</span>].scatter(</span>
<span id="cb7-11"><a href="#cb7-11" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    meuse[<span class="st">"x"</span>], meuse[<span class="st">"y"</span>], c<span class="op">=</span>meuse[<span class="st">"zinc"</span>], s<span class="op">=</span><span class="dv">55</span>,</span>
<span id="cb7-12"><a href="#cb7-12" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    cmap<span class="op">=</span><span class="st">"viridis"</span>, edgecolor<span class="op">=</span><span class="st">"black"</span>, linewidth<span class="op">=</span><span class="fl">0.25</span></span>
<span id="cb7-13"><a href="#cb7-13" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>)</span>
<span id="cb7-14"><a href="#cb7-14" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>axes[<span class="dv">2</span>].set_title(<span class="st">"Observed zinc"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb7-15"><a href="#cb7-15" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>axes[<span class="dv">2</span>].set_aspect(<span class="st">"equal"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb7-16"><a href="#cb7-16" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>axes[<span class="dv">2</span>].set_xlabel(<span class="st">"Easting (m)"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb7-17"><a href="#cb7-17" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>axes[<span class="dv">2</span>].set_ylabel(<span class="st">"Northing (m)"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb7-18"><a href="#cb7-18" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>fig.colorbar(sc, ax<span class="op">=</span>axes[<span class="dv">2</span>], label<span class="op">=</span><span class="st">"mg kg$^{-1}$"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb7-19"><a href="#cb7-19" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb7-20"><a href="#cb7-20" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>plt.tight_layout()</span>
<span id="cb7-21"><a href="#cb7-21" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>plt.show()</span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>

<section id="experimental-design" class="level2">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="experimental-design">4. Experimental design</h2>
<p>We use a factorial comparison so that the RFSI effect is not confused with the covariate effect.</p>
<table class="caption-top table">
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 33%">
<col style="width: 33%">
<col style="width: 33%">
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr class="header">
<th>Covariate scenario</th>
<th>Environmental predictors available at points and grid</th>
<th>Purpose</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="odd">
<td><code>distance_only</code></td>
<td><code>dist</code></td>
<td>Minimal environmental baseline: normalized distance to the river</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td><code>distance_flood</code></td>
<td><code>dist</code>, <code>ffreq</code></td>
<td>Adds inundation frequency</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td><code>distance_soil</code></td>
<td><code>dist</code>, <code>soil</code></td>
<td>Adds mapped soil type without flood frequency</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td><code>distance_flood_soil</code></td>
<td><code>dist</code>, <code>ffreq</code>, <code>soil</code></td>
<td>Adds inundation frequency and mapped soil type</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p>Within each scenario:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>RF</strong> uses only the listed environmental predictors.</li>
<li><strong>RFSI</strong> uses the same predictors plus <span class="math inline">\(k\)</span> nearest zinc observations and their Euclidean distances.</li>
</ul>
<p><code>ffreq</code> is categorical: class 1 = flooding once in two years, class 2 = once in ten years, and class 3 = once in 50 years. It is one-hot encoded rather than treated as a linear numeric scale. <code>soil</code> is also categorical. Comparing <code>distance_flood</code> with <code>distance_only</code> isolates the added contribution of flooding frequency, while comparing <code>distance_soil</code> with <code>distance_only</code> isolates the added contribution of soil type. The <code>distance_flood_soil</code> scenario evaluates their combined contribution.</p>
<p><strong>Limitations:</strong> According to the dataset documentation, the origin of the gridded flood-frequency map is not known and the gridded soil classes should be treated cautiously.</p>
</section>
<section id="accuracy-measures" class="level2">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="accuracy-measures">5. Accuracy measures</h2>
<ul>
<li><strong>RMSE:</strong> same units as zinc and sensitive to large errors; the primary metric in the RFSI paper.</li>
<li><strong>MAE:</strong> typical absolute error and less dominated by extremes.</li>
<li><strong><span class="math inline">\(R^2\)</span>:</strong> proportional reduction in squared error relative to predicting the overall mean. It can be negative under CV.</li>
<li><strong>Mean error (ME):</strong> signed bias; values near zero are desirable.</li>
<li><strong>CCC:</strong> agreement with the 1:1 line; unlike correlation alone, it penalizes both scale and mean bias.</li>
</ul>
<p>Scores are computed from all out-of-fold predictions pooled together. Fold scores are retained for diagnostics, but simply averaging five fold <span class="math inline">\(R^2\)</span> values is avoided because folds have different target means and variances.</p>
<div id="7c750a40-5625-494f-86d7-cda3f6a3e9d2" class="cell" data-execution_count="6">
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode cell-code" id="cb9"><pre class="sourceCode python code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode python"><span id="cb9-1"><a href="#cb9-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="kw">def</span> concordance_correlation_coefficient(y_true, y_pred):</span>
<span id="cb9-2"><a href="#cb9-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    y_true <span class="op">=</span> np.asarray(y_true, dtype<span class="op">=</span><span class="bu">float</span>)</span>
<span id="cb9-3"><a href="#cb9-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    y_pred <span class="op">=</span> np.asarray(y_pred, dtype<span class="op">=</span><span class="bu">float</span>)</span>
<span id="cb9-4"><a href="#cb9-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    cov <span class="op">=</span> np.cov(y_true, y_pred, ddof<span class="op">=</span><span class="dv">1</span>)[<span class="dv">0</span>, <span class="dv">1</span>]</span>
<span id="cb9-5"><a href="#cb9-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    denominator <span class="op">=</span> (</span>
<span id="cb9-6"><a href="#cb9-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        np.var(y_true, ddof<span class="op">=</span><span class="dv">1</span>)</span>
<span id="cb9-7"><a href="#cb9-7" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        <span class="op">+</span> np.var(y_pred, ddof<span class="op">=</span><span class="dv">1</span>)</span>
<span id="cb9-8"><a href="#cb9-8" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        <span class="op">+</span> (np.mean(y_true) <span class="op">-</span> np.mean(y_pred)) <span class="op">**</span> <span class="dv">2</span></span>
<span id="cb9-9"><a href="#cb9-9" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    )</span>
<span id="cb9-10"><a href="#cb9-10" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="cf">return</span> <span class="dv">2</span> <span class="op">*</span> cov <span class="op">/</span> denominator</span>
<span id="cb9-11"><a href="#cb9-11" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb9-12"><a href="#cb9-12" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb9-13"><a href="#cb9-13" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="kw">def</span> regression_metrics(y_true, y_pred):</span>
<span id="cb9-14"><a href="#cb9-14" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    y_true <span class="op">=</span> np.asarray(y_true, dtype<span class="op">=</span><span class="bu">float</span>)</span>
<span id="cb9-15"><a href="#cb9-15" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    y_pred <span class="op">=</span> np.asarray(y_pred, dtype<span class="op">=</span><span class="bu">float</span>)</span>
<span id="cb9-16"><a href="#cb9-16" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="cf">return</span> {</span>
<span id="cb9-17"><a href="#cb9-17" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        <span class="st">"RMSE"</span>: mean_squared_error(y_true, y_pred) <span class="op">**</span> <span class="fl">0.5</span>,</span>
<span id="cb9-18"><a href="#cb9-18" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        <span class="st">"MAE"</span>: mean_absolute_error(y_true, y_pred),</span>
<span id="cb9-19"><a href="#cb9-19" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        <span class="st">"R2"</span>: r2_score(y_true, y_pred),</span>
<span id="cb9-20"><a href="#cb9-20" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        <span class="st">"ME"</span>: np.mean(y_pred <span class="op">-</span> y_true),</span>
<span id="cb9-21"><a href="#cb9-21" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        <span class="st">"CCC"</span>: concordance_correlation_coefficient(y_true, y_pred),</span>
<span id="cb9-22"><a href="#cb9-22" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    }</span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="constructing-leakage-safe-rfsi-predictors" class="level2">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="constructing-leakage-safe-rfsi-predictors">6. Constructing leakage-safe RFSI predictors</h2>
<p>This is the critical step.</p>
<p>For an <strong>outer training sample</strong>, find neighbours only among the outer training samples and remove the sample itself. For an <strong>outer validation sample</strong>, find neighbours only among the outer training samples. The held-out zinc values must never appear in <code>obs_1</code>, …, <code>obs_k</code>.</p>
<p>An unsafe workflow would construct nearest-observation predictors once from all 155 samples and then call <code>cross_val_score</code>. A validation sample would then often receive its own zinc or another validation zinc as a predictor. The resulting accuracy could look excellent while being invalid.</p>
<div id="fc197edd-c49a-4603-ae18-2276dc0a8be6" class="cell" data-execution_count="7">
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode cell-code" id="cb10"><pre class="sourceCode python code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode python"><span id="cb10-1"><a href="#cb10-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="kw">def</span> nearest_observation_features(</span>
<span id="cb10-2"><a href="#cb10-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    reference_xy,</span>
<span id="cb10-3"><a href="#cb10-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    reference_z,</span>
<span id="cb10-4"><a href="#cb10-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    query_xy,</span>
<span id="cb10-5"><a href="#cb10-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    k<span class="op">=</span><span class="dv">10</span>,</span>
<span id="cb10-6"><a href="#cb10-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    exclude_self<span class="op">=</span><span class="va">False</span>,</span>
<span id="cb10-7"><a href="#cb10-7" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>):</span>
<span id="cb10-8"><a href="#cb10-8" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    </span>
<span id="cb10-9"><a href="#cb10-9" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    reference_xy <span class="op">=</span> np.asarray(reference_xy, dtype<span class="op">=</span><span class="bu">float</span>)</span>
<span id="cb10-10"><a href="#cb10-10" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    reference_z <span class="op">=</span> np.asarray(reference_z, dtype<span class="op">=</span><span class="bu">float</span>)</span>
<span id="cb10-11"><a href="#cb10-11" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    query_xy <span class="op">=</span> np.asarray(query_xy, dtype<span class="op">=</span><span class="bu">float</span>)</span>
<span id="cb10-12"><a href="#cb10-12" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb10-13"><a href="#cb10-13" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    extra <span class="op">=</span> <span class="dv">1</span> <span class="cf">if</span> exclude_self <span class="cf">else</span> <span class="dv">0</span></span>
<span id="cb10-14"><a href="#cb10-14" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="cf">if</span> k <span class="op">+</span> extra <span class="op">&gt;</span> <span class="bu">len</span>(reference_xy):</span>
<span id="cb10-15"><a href="#cb10-15" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        <span class="cf">raise</span> <span class="pp">ValueError</span>(<span class="st">"k is too large for the available reference samples."</span>)</span>
<span id="cb10-16"><a href="#cb10-16" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb10-17"><a href="#cb10-17" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    search <span class="op">=</span> NearestNeighbors(n_neighbors<span class="op">=</span>k <span class="op">+</span> extra, metric<span class="op">=</span><span class="st">"euclidean"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb10-18"><a href="#cb10-18" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    search.fit(reference_xy)</span>
<span id="cb10-19"><a href="#cb10-19" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    distances, indices <span class="op">=</span> search.kneighbors(query_xy)</span>
<span id="cb10-20"><a href="#cb10-20" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb10-21"><a href="#cb10-21" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="cf">if</span> exclude_self:</span>
<span id="cb10-22"><a href="#cb10-22" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        <span class="co"># Coordinates were checked as unique; the zero-distance first neighbour</span></span>
<span id="cb10-23"><a href="#cb10-23" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        <span class="co"># is therefore the row itself and must be removed.</span></span>
<span id="cb10-24"><a href="#cb10-24" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        <span class="cf">if</span> <span class="kw">not</span> np.allclose(distances[:, <span class="dv">0</span>], <span class="dv">0</span>):</span>
<span id="cb10-25"><a href="#cb10-25" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            <span class="cf">raise</span> <span class="pp">ValueError</span>(<span class="st">"Self-neighbour was not found at distance zero."</span>)</span>
<span id="cb10-26"><a href="#cb10-26" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        distances <span class="op">=</span> distances[:, <span class="dv">1</span>:]</span>
<span id="cb10-27"><a href="#cb10-27" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        indices <span class="op">=</span> indices[:, <span class="dv">1</span>:]</span>
<span id="cb10-28"><a href="#cb10-28" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb10-29"><a href="#cb10-29" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    data <span class="op">=</span> {}</span>
<span id="cb10-30"><a href="#cb10-30" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="cf">for</span> j <span class="kw">in</span> <span class="bu">range</span>(k):</span>
<span id="cb10-31"><a href="#cb10-31" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        data[<span class="ss">f"obs_</span><span class="sc">{</span>j <span class="op">+</span> <span class="dv">1</span><span class="sc">}</span><span class="ss">"</span>] <span class="op">=</span> reference_z[indices[:, j]]</span>
<span id="cb10-32"><a href="#cb10-32" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="cf">for</span> j <span class="kw">in</span> <span class="bu">range</span>(k):</span>
<span id="cb10-33"><a href="#cb10-33" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        data[<span class="ss">f"nn_distance_</span><span class="sc">{</span>j <span class="op">+</span> <span class="dv">1</span><span class="sc">}</span><span class="ss">"</span>] <span class="op">=</span> distances[:, j]</span>
<span id="cb10-34"><a href="#cb10-34" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="cf">return</span> pd.DataFrame(data)</span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>
</div>
<div id="ac9afb7a-f902-4efb-a690-9f7d7fe85a1c" class="cell" data-execution_count="8">
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode cell-code" id="cb11"><pre class="sourceCode python code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode python"><span id="cb11-1"><a href="#cb11-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># Sanity check on the complete sample set. The closest non-self distance must</span></span>
<span id="cb11-2"><a href="#cb11-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># be positive, and obs_1 is another sample's zinc rather than the target itself.</span></span>
<span id="cb11-3"><a href="#cb11-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>demo_nn <span class="op">=</span> nearest_observation_features(</span>
<span id="cb11-4"><a href="#cb11-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    meuse[[<span class="st">"x"</span>, <span class="st">"y"</span>]], meuse[<span class="st">"zinc"</span>], meuse[[<span class="st">"x"</span>, <span class="st">"y"</span>]],</span>
<span id="cb11-5"><a href="#cb11-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    k<span class="op">=</span><span class="dv">10</span>, exclude_self<span class="op">=</span><span class="va">True</span></span>
<span id="cb11-6"><a href="#cb11-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>)</span>
<span id="cb11-7"><a href="#cb11-7" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">assert</span> (demo_nn.<span class="bu">filter</span>(like<span class="op">=</span><span class="st">"nn_distance_"</span>) <span class="op">&gt;</span> <span class="dv">0</span>).<span class="bu">all</span>().<span class="bu">all</span>()</span>
<span id="cb11-8"><a href="#cb11-8" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>display(pd.concat([meuse[[<span class="st">"zinc"</span>]].head(), demo_nn.head()], axis<span class="op">=</span><span class="dv">1</span>))</span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>

<section id="model-building-helpers" class="level2">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="model-building-helpers">7. Model-building helpers</h2>
<p>The same RF settings are used in both methods to isolate the effect of adding RFSI predictors. <code>max_features="sqrt"</code> scales the number of candidate variables with feature count, while <code>min_samples_leaf=2</code> slightly regularizes the very small dataset. These are fixed <em>before</em> looking at outer-fold results; therefore the primary comparison does not require nested tuning.</p>
<p>Categorical encoders and imputers are fitted inside each training fold. Coordinates are used only by the RFSI neighbour search, never as ordinary RF predictors.</p>
<div id="caa2b629-aa02-42c1-823d-565444354c38" class="cell" data-execution_count="9">
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode cell-code" id="cb12"><pre class="sourceCode python code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode python"><span id="cb12-1"><a href="#cb12-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>RANDOM_STATE <span class="op">=</span> <span class="dv">2026</span></span>
<span id="cb12-2"><a href="#cb12-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>N_SPLITS <span class="op">=</span> <span class="dv">5</span></span>
<span id="cb12-3"><a href="#cb12-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>K_NEIGHBORS <span class="op">=</span> <span class="dv">10</span>       <span class="co"># same k as the OpenGeoHub Meuse tutorial, is a subject to explore</span></span>
<span id="cb12-4"><a href="#cb12-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>N_TREES <span class="op">=</span> <span class="dv">600</span></span>
<span id="cb12-5"><a href="#cb12-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>N_JOBS <span class="op">=</span> <span class="op">-</span><span class="dv">1</span></span>
<span id="cb12-6"><a href="#cb12-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>CATEGORICAL_COLUMNS <span class="op">=</span> {<span class="st">"ffreq"</span>, <span class="st">"soil"</span>, <span class="st">"lime"</span>, <span class="st">"landuse"</span>}</span>
<span id="cb12-7"><a href="#cb12-7" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb12-8"><a href="#cb12-8" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb12-9"><a href="#cb12-9" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="kw">def</span> make_rf_pipeline(feature_columns, random_state<span class="op">=</span>RANDOM_STATE, n_trees<span class="op">=</span>N_TREES):</span>
<span id="cb12-10"><a href="#cb12-10" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    categorical <span class="op">=</span> [c <span class="cf">for</span> c <span class="kw">in</span> feature_columns <span class="cf">if</span> c <span class="kw">in</span> CATEGORICAL_COLUMNS]</span>
<span id="cb12-11"><a href="#cb12-11" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    numeric <span class="op">=</span> [c <span class="cf">for</span> c <span class="kw">in</span> feature_columns <span class="cf">if</span> c <span class="kw">not</span> <span class="kw">in</span> CATEGORICAL_COLUMNS]</span>
<span id="cb12-12"><a href="#cb12-12" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb12-13"><a href="#cb12-13" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    transformers <span class="op">=</span> []</span>
<span id="cb12-14"><a href="#cb12-14" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="cf">if</span> numeric:</span>
<span id="cb12-15"><a href="#cb12-15" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        transformers.append((</span>
<span id="cb12-16"><a href="#cb12-16" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            <span class="st">"numeric"</span>,</span>
<span id="cb12-17"><a href="#cb12-17" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            SimpleImputer(strategy<span class="op">=</span><span class="st">"median"</span>),</span>
<span id="cb12-18"><a href="#cb12-18" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            numeric,</span>
<span id="cb12-19"><a href="#cb12-19" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        ))</span>
<span id="cb12-20"><a href="#cb12-20" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="cf">if</span> categorical:</span>
<span id="cb12-21"><a href="#cb12-21" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        transformers.append((</span>
<span id="cb12-22"><a href="#cb12-22" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            <span class="st">"categorical"</span>,</span>
<span id="cb12-23"><a href="#cb12-23" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            Pipeline([</span>
<span id="cb12-24"><a href="#cb12-24" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>                (<span class="st">"imputer"</span>, SimpleImputer(strategy<span class="op">=</span><span class="st">"most_frequent"</span>)),</span>
<span id="cb12-25"><a href="#cb12-25" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>                (<span class="st">"onehot"</span>, OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown<span class="op">=</span><span class="st">"ignore"</span>, sparse_output<span class="op">=</span><span class="va">False</span>)),</span>
<span id="cb12-26"><a href="#cb12-26" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            ]),</span>
<span id="cb12-27"><a href="#cb12-27" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            categorical,</span>
<span id="cb12-28"><a href="#cb12-28" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        ))</span>
<span id="cb12-29"><a href="#cb12-29" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb12-30"><a href="#cb12-30" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    preprocessing <span class="op">=</span> ColumnTransformer(transformers, remainder<span class="op">=</span><span class="st">"drop"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb12-31"><a href="#cb12-31" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    forest <span class="op">=</span> RandomForestRegressor(</span>
<span id="cb12-32"><a href="#cb12-32" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        n_estimators<span class="op">=</span>n_trees,</span>
<span id="cb12-33"><a href="#cb12-33" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        max_features<span class="op">=</span><span class="st">"sqrt"</span>,</span>
<span id="cb12-34"><a href="#cb12-34" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        min_samples_leaf<span class="op">=</span><span class="dv">2</span>,</span>
<span id="cb12-35"><a href="#cb12-35" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        bootstrap<span class="op">=</span><span class="va">True</span>,</span>
<span id="cb12-36"><a href="#cb12-36" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        random_state<span class="op">=</span>random_state,</span>
<span id="cb12-37"><a href="#cb12-37" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        n_jobs<span class="op">=</span>N_JOBS,</span>
<span id="cb12-38"><a href="#cb12-38" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    )</span>
<span id="cb12-39"><a href="#cb12-39" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="cf">return</span> Pipeline([(<span class="st">"preprocess"</span>, preprocessing), (<span class="st">"rf"</span>, forest)])</span>
<span id="cb12-40"><a href="#cb12-40" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb12-41"><a href="#cb12-41" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb12-42"><a href="#cb12-42" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="kw">def</span> fold_feature_tables(train, test, environmental_columns, method, k):</span>
<span id="cb12-43"><a href="#cb12-43" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="co">'''Build train/test predictors using only the fold's training reference set.'''</span></span>
<span id="cb12-44"><a href="#cb12-44" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    X_train <span class="op">=</span> train[environmental_columns].reset_index(drop<span class="op">=</span><span class="va">True</span>).copy()</span>
<span id="cb12-45"><a href="#cb12-45" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    X_test <span class="op">=</span> test[environmental_columns].reset_index(drop<span class="op">=</span><span class="va">True</span>).copy()</span>
<span id="cb12-46"><a href="#cb12-46" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb12-47"><a href="#cb12-47" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="cf">if</span> method <span class="op">==</span> <span class="st">"RFSI"</span>:</span>
<span id="cb12-48"><a href="#cb12-48" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        train_nn <span class="op">=</span> nearest_observation_features(</span>
<span id="cb12-49"><a href="#cb12-49" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            train[[<span class="st">"x"</span>, <span class="st">"y"</span>]], train[<span class="st">"zinc"</span>], train[[<span class="st">"x"</span>, <span class="st">"y"</span>]],</span>
<span id="cb12-50"><a href="#cb12-50" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            k<span class="op">=</span>k, exclude_self<span class="op">=</span><span class="va">True</span>,</span>
<span id="cb12-51"><a href="#cb12-51" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        )</span>
<span id="cb12-52"><a href="#cb12-52" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        test_nn <span class="op">=</span> nearest_observation_features(</span>
<span id="cb12-53"><a href="#cb12-53" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            train[[<span class="st">"x"</span>, <span class="st">"y"</span>]], train[<span class="st">"zinc"</span>], test[[<span class="st">"x"</span>, <span class="st">"y"</span>]],</span>
<span id="cb12-54"><a href="#cb12-54" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            k<span class="op">=</span>k, exclude_self<span class="op">=</span><span class="va">False</span>,</span>
<span id="cb12-55"><a href="#cb12-55" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        )</span>
<span id="cb12-56"><a href="#cb12-56" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        X_train <span class="op">=</span> pd.concat([X_train, train_nn], axis<span class="op">=</span><span class="dv">1</span>)</span>
<span id="cb12-57"><a href="#cb12-57" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        X_test <span class="op">=</span> pd.concat([X_test, test_nn], axis<span class="op">=</span><span class="dv">1</span>)</span>
<span id="cb12-58"><a href="#cb12-58" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="cf">elif</span> method <span class="op">!=</span> <span class="st">"RF"</span>:</span>
<span id="cb12-59"><a href="#cb12-59" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        <span class="cf">raise</span> <span class="pp">ValueError</span>(<span class="st">"method must be 'RF' or 'RFSI'"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb12-60"><a href="#cb12-60" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb12-61"><a href="#cb12-61" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="cf">return</span> X_train, X_test</span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="primary-shuffled-5-fold-cross-validation" class="level2">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="primary-shuffled-5-fold-cross-validation">8. Primary shuffled 5-fold cross-validation</h2>
<p>The primary resampling design is shuffled 5-fold CV. Because every Meuse sample has a unique location, holding out a row also holds out that location. It estimates <strong>interpolation among a remaining, spatially interspersed sample network</strong>. A spatially clustered 5-fold sensitivity test is included later; it asks the harder question of prediction into withheld geographic subregions and should not be interpreted as the same estimand.</p>
<p>Both methods and all four covariate scenarios use the <strong>same folds</strong>, making all comparisons paired. Within every fold, the reference network available to RFSI contains only 80% of the observations. This honestly reproduces the information available when predicting a withheld location.</p>
<p>No target transformation is used in the primary analysis.</p>
<div id="f127af2b-540a-445e-a48b-c3f1fa36fe53" class="cell" data-execution_count="10">
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode cell-code" id="cb13"><pre class="sourceCode python code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode python"><span id="cb13-1"><a href="#cb13-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>sns.set_theme(style<span class="op">=</span><span class="st">"whitegrid"</span>, context<span class="op">=</span><span class="st">"notebook"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb13-2"><a href="#cb13-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>pd.set_option(<span class="st">"display.max_columns"</span>, <span class="dv">100</span>)</span>
<span id="cb13-3"><a href="#cb13-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb13-4"><a href="#cb13-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="kw">def</span> make_random_folds(data, random_state<span class="op">=</span>RANDOM_STATE):</span>
<span id="cb13-5"><a href="#cb13-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    splitter <span class="op">=</span> KFold(n_splits<span class="op">=</span>N_SPLITS, shuffle<span class="op">=</span><span class="va">True</span>, random_state<span class="op">=</span>random_state)</span>
<span id="cb13-6"><a href="#cb13-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="cf">return</span> <span class="bu">list</span>(splitter.split(data))</span>
<span id="cb13-7"><a href="#cb13-7" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb13-8"><a href="#cb13-8" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb13-9"><a href="#cb13-9" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="kw">def</span> cross_validate_method(</span>
<span id="cb13-10"><a href="#cb13-10" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    data,</span>
<span id="cb13-11"><a href="#cb13-11" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    folds,</span>
<span id="cb13-12"><a href="#cb13-12" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    environmental_columns,</span>
<span id="cb13-13"><a href="#cb13-13" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    method,</span>
<span id="cb13-14"><a href="#cb13-14" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    k<span class="op">=</span>K_NEIGHBORS,</span>
<span id="cb13-15"><a href="#cb13-15" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    n_trees<span class="op">=</span>N_TREES,</span>
<span id="cb13-16"><a href="#cb13-16" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>):</span>
<span id="cb13-17"><a href="#cb13-17" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    oof <span class="op">=</span> np.full(<span class="bu">len</span>(data), np.nan)</span>
<span id="cb13-18"><a href="#cb13-18" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    fold_id <span class="op">=</span> np.full(<span class="bu">len</span>(data), <span class="op">-</span><span class="dv">1</span>, dtype<span class="op">=</span><span class="bu">int</span>)</span>
<span id="cb13-19"><a href="#cb13-19" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb13-20"><a href="#cb13-20" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="cf">for</span> fold_number, (train_index, test_index) <span class="kw">in</span> <span class="bu">enumerate</span>(folds, start<span class="op">=</span><span class="dv">1</span>):</span>
<span id="cb13-21"><a href="#cb13-21" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        train <span class="op">=</span> data.iloc[train_index].reset_index(drop<span class="op">=</span><span class="va">True</span>)</span>
<span id="cb13-22"><a href="#cb13-22" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        test <span class="op">=</span> data.iloc[test_index].reset_index(drop<span class="op">=</span><span class="va">True</span>)</span>
<span id="cb13-23"><a href="#cb13-23" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb13-24"><a href="#cb13-24" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        X_train, X_test <span class="op">=</span> fold_feature_tables(</span>
<span id="cb13-25"><a href="#cb13-25" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            train, test, environmental_columns, method, k</span>
<span id="cb13-26"><a href="#cb13-26" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        )</span>
<span id="cb13-27"><a href="#cb13-27" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        model <span class="op">=</span> make_rf_pipeline(</span>
<span id="cb13-28"><a href="#cb13-28" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            X_train.columns.tolist(),</span>
<span id="cb13-29"><a href="#cb13-29" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            random_state<span class="op">=</span>RANDOM_STATE <span class="op">+</span> fold_number,</span>
<span id="cb13-30"><a href="#cb13-30" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            n_trees<span class="op">=</span>n_trees,</span>
<span id="cb13-31"><a href="#cb13-31" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        )</span>
<span id="cb13-32"><a href="#cb13-32" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        model.fit(X_train, train[<span class="st">"zinc"</span>])</span>
<span id="cb13-33"><a href="#cb13-33" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        oof[test_index] <span class="op">=</span> model.predict(X_test)</span>
<span id="cb13-34"><a href="#cb13-34" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        fold_id[test_index] <span class="op">=</span> fold_number</span>
<span id="cb13-35"><a href="#cb13-35" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb13-36"><a href="#cb13-36" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="cf">assert</span> np.isfinite(oof).<span class="bu">all</span>()</span>
<span id="cb13-37"><a href="#cb13-37" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="cf">return</span> pd.DataFrame({</span>
<span id="cb13-38"><a href="#cb13-38" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        <span class="st">"observed"</span>: data[<span class="st">"zinc"</span>].to_numpy(),</span>
<span id="cb13-39"><a href="#cb13-39" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        <span class="st">"predicted"</span>: oof,</span>
<span id="cb13-40"><a href="#cb13-40" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        <span class="st">"fold"</span>: fold_id,</span>
<span id="cb13-41"><a href="#cb13-41" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        <span class="st">"x"</span>: data[<span class="st">"x"</span>].to_numpy(),</span>
<span id="cb13-42"><a href="#cb13-42" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        <span class="st">"y"</span>: data[<span class="st">"y"</span>].to_numpy(),</span>
<span id="cb13-43"><a href="#cb13-43" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    })</span>
<span id="cb13-44"><a href="#cb13-44" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb13-45"><a href="#cb13-45" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb13-46"><a href="#cb13-46" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>SCENARIOS <span class="op">=</span> {</span>
<span id="cb13-47"><a href="#cb13-47" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="st">"distance_only"</span>: [<span class="st">"dist"</span>],</span>
<span id="cb13-48"><a href="#cb13-48" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="st">"distance_flood"</span>: [<span class="st">"dist"</span>, <span class="st">"ffreq"</span>],</span>
<span id="cb13-49"><a href="#cb13-49" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="st">"distance_soil"</span>: [<span class="st">"dist"</span>, <span class="st">"soil"</span>],</span>
<span id="cb13-50"><a href="#cb13-50" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="st">"distance_flood_soil"</span>: [<span class="st">"dist"</span>, <span class="st">"ffreq"</span>, <span class="st">"soil"</span>],</span>
<span id="cb13-51"><a href="#cb13-51" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>}</span>
<span id="cb13-52"><a href="#cb13-52" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb13-53"><a href="#cb13-53" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>primary_folds <span class="op">=</span> make_random_folds(meuse)</span>
<span id="cb13-54"><a href="#cb13-54" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>predictions <span class="op">=</span> {}</span>
<span id="cb13-55"><a href="#cb13-55" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb13-56"><a href="#cb13-56" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">for</span> scenario, columns <span class="kw">in</span> SCENARIOS.items():</span>
<span id="cb13-57"><a href="#cb13-57" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="cf">for</span> method <span class="kw">in</span> [<span class="st">"RF"</span>, <span class="st">"RFSI"</span>]:</span>
<span id="cb13-58"><a href="#cb13-58" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        <span class="bu">print</span>(<span class="ss">f"Running </span><span class="sc">{</span>scenario<span class="sc">}</span><span class="ss"> / </span><span class="sc">{</span>method<span class="sc">}</span><span class="ss">"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb13-59"><a href="#cb13-59" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        predictions[(scenario, method)] <span class="op">=</span> cross_validate_method(</span>
<span id="cb13-60"><a href="#cb13-60" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            meuse, primary_folds, columns, method, k<span class="op">=</span>K_NEIGHBORS</span>
<span id="cb13-61"><a href="#cb13-61" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        )</span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>
<div class="cell-output cell-output-stdout">
<pre><code>Running distance_only / RF
Running distance_only / RFSI
Running distance_flood / RF
Running distance_flood / RFSI
Running distance_soil / RF
Running distance_soil / RFSI
Running distance_flood_soil / RF
Running distance_flood_soil / RFSI</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="overall-and-fold-level-accuracy" class="level2">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="overall-and-fold-level-accuracy">9. Overall and fold-level accuracy</h2>
<p>Interpretation notes:</p>
<p>Lower RMSE/MAE and absolute ME, but higher <span class="math inline">\(R^2\)</span>/CCC - better. A negative <code>delta_RMSE</code> means RFSI is more accurate than RF. It’s better not to call a tiny numerical difference scientifically important merely because it has the preferred sign. We should consider its size relative to RF RMSE, its stability across folds and seeds, and its uncertainty.</p>
<div id="036502ce-de5c-4906-bac0-393be40c4b9c" class="cell" data-execution_count="11">
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode cell-code" id="cb15"><pre class="sourceCode python code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode python"><span id="cb15-1"><a href="#cb15-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>scenario_order <span class="op">=</span> [<span class="st">"distance_only"</span>, <span class="st">"distance_flood"</span>, <span class="st">"distance_soil"</span>, <span class="st">"distance_flood_soil"</span>]</span>
<span id="cb15-2"><a href="#cb15-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb15-3"><a href="#cb15-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>overall_rows <span class="op">=</span> []</span>
<span id="cb15-4"><a href="#cb15-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>fold_rows <span class="op">=</span> []</span>
<span id="cb15-5"><a href="#cb15-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb15-6"><a href="#cb15-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">for</span> (scenario, method), result <span class="kw">in</span> predictions.items():</span>
<span id="cb15-7"><a href="#cb15-7" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    overall_rows.append({</span>
<span id="cb15-8"><a href="#cb15-8" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        <span class="st">"scenario"</span>: scenario,</span>
<span id="cb15-9"><a href="#cb15-9" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        <span class="st">"method"</span>: method,</span>
<span id="cb15-10"><a href="#cb15-10" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        <span class="op">**</span>regression_metrics(result[<span class="st">"observed"</span>], result[<span class="st">"predicted"</span>]),</span>
<span id="cb15-11"><a href="#cb15-11" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    })</span>
<span id="cb15-12"><a href="#cb15-12" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="cf">for</span> fold_number, part <span class="kw">in</span> result.groupby(<span class="st">"fold"</span>):</span>
<span id="cb15-13"><a href="#cb15-13" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        fold_rows.append({</span>
<span id="cb15-14"><a href="#cb15-14" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            <span class="st">"scenario"</span>: scenario,</span>
<span id="cb15-15"><a href="#cb15-15" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            <span class="st">"method"</span>: method,</span>
<span id="cb15-16"><a href="#cb15-16" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            <span class="st">"fold"</span>: fold_number,</span>
<span id="cb15-17"><a href="#cb15-17" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            <span class="op">**</span>regression_metrics(part[<span class="st">"observed"</span>], part[<span class="st">"predicted"</span>]),</span>
<span id="cb15-18"><a href="#cb15-18" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        })</span>
<span id="cb15-19"><a href="#cb15-19" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb15-20"><a href="#cb15-20" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>overall_scores <span class="op">=</span> pd.DataFrame(overall_rows)</span>
<span id="cb15-21"><a href="#cb15-21" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>overall_scores[<span class="st">"scenario"</span>] <span class="op">=</span> pd.Categorical(</span>
<span id="cb15-22"><a href="#cb15-22" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    overall_scores[<span class="st">"scenario"</span>], categories<span class="op">=</span>scenario_order, ordered<span class="op">=</span><span class="va">True</span></span>
<span id="cb15-23"><a href="#cb15-23" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>)</span>
<span id="cb15-24"><a href="#cb15-24" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>overall_scores <span class="op">=</span> overall_scores.sort_values([<span class="st">"scenario"</span>, <span class="st">"method"</span>])</span>
<span id="cb15-25"><a href="#cb15-25" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb15-26"><a href="#cb15-26" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>fold_scores <span class="op">=</span> pd.DataFrame(fold_rows)</span>
<span id="cb15-27"><a href="#cb15-27" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>fold_scores[<span class="st">"scenario"</span>] <span class="op">=</span> pd.Categorical(</span>
<span id="cb15-28"><a href="#cb15-28" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    fold_scores[<span class="st">"scenario"</span>], categories<span class="op">=</span>scenario_order, ordered<span class="op">=</span><span class="va">True</span></span>
<span id="cb15-29"><a href="#cb15-29" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>)</span>
<span id="cb15-30"><a href="#cb15-30" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>fold_scores <span class="op">=</span> fold_scores.sort_values([<span class="st">"scenario"</span>, <span class="st">"fold"</span>, <span class="st">"method"</span>])</span>
<span id="cb15-31"><a href="#cb15-31" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb15-32"><a href="#cb15-32" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>display(overall_scores.<span class="bu">round</span>(<span class="dv">3</span>))</span>
<span id="cb15-33"><a href="#cb15-33" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb15-34"><a href="#cb15-34" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>wide <span class="op">=</span> overall_scores.pivot(index<span class="op">=</span><span class="st">"scenario"</span>, columns<span class="op">=</span><span class="st">"method"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb15-35"><a href="#cb15-35" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>wide <span class="op">=</span> wide.reindex(scenario_order)</span>
<span id="cb15-36"><a href="#cb15-36" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb15-37"><a href="#cb15-37" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>method_effect <span class="op">=</span> pd.DataFrame(index<span class="op">=</span>wide.index)</span>
<span id="cb15-38"><a href="#cb15-38" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>method_effect[<span class="st">"delta_RMSE"</span>] <span class="op">=</span> wide[<span class="st">"RMSE"</span>][<span class="st">"RFSI"</span>] <span class="op">-</span> wide[<span class="st">"RMSE"</span>][<span class="st">"RF"</span>]</span>
<span id="cb15-39"><a href="#cb15-39" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>method_effect[<span class="st">"RMSE_change_percent"</span>] <span class="op">=</span> <span class="dv">100</span> <span class="op">*</span> method_effect[<span class="st">"delta_RMSE"</span>] <span class="op">/</span> wide[<span class="st">"RMSE"</span>][<span class="st">"RF"</span>]</span>
<span id="cb15-40"><a href="#cb15-40" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>method_effect[<span class="st">"delta_MAE"</span>] <span class="op">=</span> wide[<span class="st">"MAE"</span>][<span class="st">"RFSI"</span>] <span class="op">-</span> wide[<span class="st">"MAE"</span>][<span class="st">"RF"</span>]</span>
<span id="cb15-41"><a href="#cb15-41" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>method_effect[<span class="st">"delta_R2"</span>] <span class="op">=</span> wide[<span class="st">"R2"</span>][<span class="st">"RFSI"</span>] <span class="op">-</span> wide[<span class="st">"R2"</span>][<span class="st">"RF"</span>]</span>
<span id="cb15-42"><a href="#cb15-42" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>method_effect[<span class="st">"delta_CCC"</span>] <span class="op">=</span> wide[<span class="st">"CCC"</span>][<span class="st">"RFSI"</span>] <span class="op">-</span> wide[<span class="st">"CCC"</span>][<span class="st">"RF"</span>]</span>
<span id="cb15-43"><a href="#cb15-43" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb15-44"><a href="#cb15-44" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>display(method_effect.<span class="bu">round</span>(<span class="dv">3</span>))</span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>

<section id="residual-maps" class="level3">
<h3 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="residual-maps">Residual maps</h3>
<p>Spatial clustering of residuals indicates structure not captured by the model. Similar residual clusters in RF and RFSI may reflect missing environmental processes, outliers, or a mismatch between sampling support and raster support. Remember that every point shown below is an out-of-fold prediction.</p>
<div id="84d17caa-7577-4fe6-bf45-8b60ed515b9e" class="cell" data-execution_count="13">
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode cell-code" id="cb17"><pre class="sourceCode python code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode python"><span id="cb17-1"><a href="#cb17-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>n_scenarios <span class="op">=</span> <span class="bu">len</span>(SCENARIOS)</span>
<span id="cb17-2"><a href="#cb17-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>fig, axes <span class="op">=</span> plt.subplots(</span>
<span id="cb17-3"><a href="#cb17-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    n_scenarios, <span class="dv">2</span>, figsize<span class="op">=</span>(<span class="dv">12</span>, <span class="fl">5.2</span> <span class="op">*</span> n_scenarios),</span>
<span id="cb17-4"><a href="#cb17-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    sharex<span class="op">=</span><span class="va">True</span>, sharey<span class="op">=</span><span class="va">True</span>, squeeze<span class="op">=</span><span class="va">False</span></span>
<span id="cb17-5"><a href="#cb17-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>)</span>
<span id="cb17-6"><a href="#cb17-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>residual_limit <span class="op">=</span> <span class="bu">max</span>(</span>
<span id="cb17-7"><a href="#cb17-7" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    np.<span class="bu">abs</span>(v[<span class="st">"predicted"</span>] <span class="op">-</span> v[<span class="st">"observed"</span>]).<span class="bu">max</span>() <span class="cf">for</span> v <span class="kw">in</span> predictions.values()</span>
<span id="cb17-8"><a href="#cb17-8" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>)</span>
<span id="cb17-9"><a href="#cb17-9" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb17-10"><a href="#cb17-10" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">for</span> row, scenario <span class="kw">in</span> <span class="bu">enumerate</span>(SCENARIOS):</span>
<span id="cb17-11"><a href="#cb17-11" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="cf">for</span> column, method <span class="kw">in</span> <span class="bu">enumerate</span>([<span class="st">"RF"</span>, <span class="st">"RFSI"</span>]):</span>
<span id="cb17-12"><a href="#cb17-12" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        ax <span class="op">=</span> axes[row, column]</span>
<span id="cb17-13"><a href="#cb17-13" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        result <span class="op">=</span> predictions[(scenario, method)]</span>
<span id="cb17-14"><a href="#cb17-14" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        residual <span class="op">=</span> result[<span class="st">"predicted"</span>] <span class="op">-</span> result[<span class="st">"observed"</span>]</span>
<span id="cb17-15"><a href="#cb17-15" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        sc <span class="op">=</span> ax.scatter(</span>
<span id="cb17-16"><a href="#cb17-16" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            result[<span class="st">"x"</span>], result[<span class="st">"y"</span>], c<span class="op">=</span>residual, cmap<span class="op">=</span><span class="st">"RdBu_r"</span>,</span>
<span id="cb17-17"><a href="#cb17-17" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            vmin<span class="op">=-</span>residual_limit, vmax<span class="op">=</span>residual_limit, s<span class="op">=</span><span class="dv">48</span>,</span>
<span id="cb17-18"><a href="#cb17-18" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            edgecolor<span class="op">=</span><span class="st">"black"</span>, linewidth<span class="op">=</span><span class="fl">0.2</span></span>
<span id="cb17-19"><a href="#cb17-19" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        )</span>
<span id="cb17-20"><a href="#cb17-20" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        ax.set_title(<span class="ss">f"</span><span class="sc">{</span>scenario<span class="sc">}</span><span class="ss"> / </span><span class="sc">{</span>method<span class="sc">}</span><span class="ss">"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb17-21"><a href="#cb17-21" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        ax.set_aspect(<span class="st">"equal"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb17-22"><a href="#cb17-22" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        ax.set_xlabel(<span class="st">"Easting (m)"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb17-23"><a href="#cb17-23" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        ax.set_ylabel(<span class="st">"Northing (m)"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb17-24"><a href="#cb17-24" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb17-25"><a href="#cb17-25" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>fig.colorbar(</span>
<span id="cb17-26"><a href="#cb17-26" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    sc, ax<span class="op">=</span>axes.ravel().tolist(), shrink<span class="op">=</span><span class="fl">0.55</span>,</span>
<span id="cb17-27"><a href="#cb17-27" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    label<span class="op">=</span><span class="st">"Prediction − observation (mg kg$^{-1}$)"</span></span>
<span id="cb17-28"><a href="#cb17-28" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>)</span>
<span id="cb17-29"><a href="#cb17-29" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>plt.show()</span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>

<figure class="figure">
<p><img src="RFSI_vs_RF_Meuse_Zinc_Kachalova_files/figure-html/cell-14-output-1.png" class="img-fluid figure-img"></p>
</figure>
</div>
</div>
</div>
