<section id="paired-uncertainty-assessment-with-a-spatial-block-bootstrap" class="level2">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="paired-uncertainty-assessment-with-a-spatial-block-bootstrap">10. Paired uncertainty assessment with a spatial block bootstrap</h2>
<p>The same observations and folds are used for RF and RFSI, so uncertainty should be evaluated on their <strong>paired difference</strong>. A naive independent-samples test would discard this pairing. A naive point bootstrap would also treat spatially correlated errors as independent.</p>
<p>The approximation below partitions observations into ten spatial clusters, resamples whole clusters, and recalculates <span class="math inline">\(\Delta RMSE = RMSE_{RFSI}-RMSE_{RF}\)</span>. A 95% interval entirely below zero supports an RFSI improvement for this CV design. An interval crossing zero means the data do not clearly distinguish the methods. This is an uncertainty/sensitivity analysis, not a definitive universal hypothesis test: the sample is small, block definitions are subjective, and OOF predictions depend on the chosen folds.</p>
<div id="495fa32b-33d3-4eca-93ab-4eb3b0df10c1" class="cell" data-execution_count="14">
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode cell-code" id="cb18"><pre class="sourceCode python code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode python"><span id="cb18-1"><a href="#cb18-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="kw">def</span> spatial_block_bootstrap_delta_rmse(</span>
<span id="cb18-2"><a href="#cb18-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    observed, pred_rf, pred_rfsi, xy,</span>
<span id="cb18-3"><a href="#cb18-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    n_blocks<span class="op">=</span><span class="dv">10</span>, n_boot<span class="op">=</span><span class="dv">5000</span>, random_state<span class="op">=</span>RANDOM_STATE,</span>
<span id="cb18-4"><a href="#cb18-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>):</span>
<span id="cb18-5"><a href="#cb18-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    xy <span class="op">=</span> np.asarray(xy, dtype<span class="op">=</span><span class="bu">float</span>)</span>
<span id="cb18-6"><a href="#cb18-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="co"># Standardization prevents the larger coordinate range from dominating clustering.</span></span>
<span id="cb18-7"><a href="#cb18-7" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    xy_scaled <span class="op">=</span> (xy <span class="op">-</span> xy.mean(axis<span class="op">=</span><span class="dv">0</span>)) <span class="op">/</span> xy.std(axis<span class="op">=</span><span class="dv">0</span>)</span>
<span id="cb18-8"><a href="#cb18-8" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    blocks <span class="op">=</span> KMeans(n_clusters<span class="op">=</span>n_blocks, n_init<span class="op">=</span><span class="dv">20</span>, random_state<span class="op">=</span>random_state).fit_predict(xy_scaled)</span>
<span id="cb18-9"><a href="#cb18-9" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    block_labels <span class="op">=</span> np.unique(blocks)</span>
<span id="cb18-10"><a href="#cb18-10" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    rng <span class="op">=</span> np.random.default_rng(random_state)</span>
<span id="cb18-11"><a href="#cb18-11" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    deltas <span class="op">=</span> np.empty(n_boot)</span>
<span id="cb18-12"><a href="#cb18-12" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb18-13"><a href="#cb18-13" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="cf">for</span> b <span class="kw">in</span> <span class="bu">range</span>(n_boot):</span>
<span id="cb18-14"><a href="#cb18-14" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        sampled_blocks <span class="op">=</span> rng.choice(block_labels, size<span class="op">=</span><span class="bu">len</span>(block_labels), replace<span class="op">=</span><span class="va">True</span>)</span>
<span id="cb18-15"><a href="#cb18-15" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        index <span class="op">=</span> np.concatenate([np.flatnonzero(blocks <span class="op">==</span> label) <span class="cf">for</span> label <span class="kw">in</span> sampled_blocks])</span>
<span id="cb18-16"><a href="#cb18-16" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        rmse_rf <span class="op">=</span> mean_squared_error(observed[index], pred_rf[index]) <span class="op">**</span> <span class="fl">0.5</span></span>
<span id="cb18-17"><a href="#cb18-17" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        rmse_rfsi <span class="op">=</span> mean_squared_error(observed[index], pred_rfsi[index]) <span class="op">**</span> <span class="fl">0.5</span></span>
<span id="cb18-18"><a href="#cb18-18" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        deltas[b] <span class="op">=</span> rmse_rfsi <span class="op">-</span> rmse_rf</span>
<span id="cb18-19"><a href="#cb18-19" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="cf">return</span> deltas, blocks</span>
<span id="cb18-20"><a href="#cb18-20" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb18-21"><a href="#cb18-21" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb18-22"><a href="#cb18-22" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>bootstrap_rows <span class="op">=</span> []</span>
<span id="cb18-23"><a href="#cb18-23" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>bootstrap_distributions <span class="op">=</span> {}</span>
<span id="cb18-24"><a href="#cb18-24" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb18-25"><a href="#cb18-25" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">for</span> scenario <span class="kw">in</span> SCENARIOS:</span>
<span id="cb18-26"><a href="#cb18-26" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    rf <span class="op">=</span> predictions[(scenario, <span class="st">"RF"</span>)]</span>
<span id="cb18-27"><a href="#cb18-27" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    rfsi <span class="op">=</span> predictions[(scenario, <span class="st">"RFSI"</span>)]</span>
<span id="cb18-28"><a href="#cb18-28" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    deltas, spatial_blocks <span class="op">=</span> spatial_block_bootstrap_delta_rmse(</span>
<span id="cb18-29"><a href="#cb18-29" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        rf[<span class="st">"observed"</span>].to_numpy(),</span>
<span id="cb18-30"><a href="#cb18-30" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        rf[<span class="st">"predicted"</span>].to_numpy(),</span>
<span id="cb18-31"><a href="#cb18-31" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        rfsi[<span class="st">"predicted"</span>].to_numpy(),</span>
<span id="cb18-32"><a href="#cb18-32" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        meuse[[<span class="st">"x"</span>, <span class="st">"y"</span>]].to_numpy(),</span>
<span id="cb18-33"><a href="#cb18-33" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    )</span>
<span id="cb18-34"><a href="#cb18-34" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    bootstrap_distributions[scenario] <span class="op">=</span> deltas</span>
<span id="cb18-35"><a href="#cb18-35" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    low, high <span class="op">=</span> np.quantile(deltas, [<span class="fl">0.025</span>, <span class="fl">0.975</span>])</span>
<span id="cb18-36"><a href="#cb18-36" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    bootstrap_rows.append({</span>
<span id="cb18-37"><a href="#cb18-37" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        <span class="st">"scenario"</span>: scenario,</span>
<span id="cb18-38"><a href="#cb18-38" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        <span class="st">"observed_delta_RMSE"</span>: (</span>
<span id="cb18-39"><a href="#cb18-39" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            regression_metrics(rfsi[<span class="st">"observed"</span>], rfsi[<span class="st">"predicted"</span>])[<span class="st">"RMSE"</span>]</span>
<span id="cb18-40"><a href="#cb18-40" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            <span class="op">-</span> regression_metrics(rf[<span class="st">"observed"</span>], rf[<span class="st">"predicted"</span>])[<span class="st">"RMSE"</span>]</span>
<span id="cb18-41"><a href="#cb18-41" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        ),</span>
<span id="cb18-42"><a href="#cb18-42" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        <span class="st">"bootstrap_CI_low"</span>: low,</span>
<span id="cb18-43"><a href="#cb18-43" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        <span class="st">"bootstrap_CI_high"</span>: high,</span>
<span id="cb18-44"><a href="#cb18-44" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        <span class="st">"P(delta_RMSE &lt; 0)"</span>: np.mean(deltas <span class="op">&lt;</span> <span class="dv">0</span>),</span>
<span id="cb18-45"><a href="#cb18-45" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    })</span>
<span id="cb18-46"><a href="#cb18-46" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb18-47"><a href="#cb18-47" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>bootstrap_summary <span class="op">=</span> pd.DataFrame(bootstrap_rows)</span>
<span id="cb18-48"><a href="#cb18-48" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>display(bootstrap_summary.<span class="bu">round</span>(<span class="dv">3</span>))</span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>

<section id="fit-the-full-models-and-create-prediction-maps" class="level2">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="fit-the-full-models-and-create-prediction-maps">11. Fit the full models and create prediction maps</h2>
<p>Cross-validation evaluates performance; final fitting creates maps. For the final RFSI model, training-sample features exclude self, while grid-cell features use all 155 observed samples as the reference network.</p>
<p>Only <code>dist</code>, <code>ffreq</code>, and <code>soil</code> are used because all three are available both at sample points and on <code>meuse.grid</code>. Point-only attributes such as organic matter, field elevation, lime, and land use cannot be used for wall-to-wall prediction unless equivalent raster layers are supplied for every grid cell.</p>
<div id="2d28894e-2e31-4b0c-8e7d-1e6eda97d7d0" class="cell" data-execution_count="16">
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode cell-code" id="cb20"><pre class="sourceCode python code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode python"><span id="cb20-1"><a href="#cb20-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="kw">def</span> fit_full_and_predict_grid(</span>
<span id="cb20-2"><a href="#cb20-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    data,</span>
<span id="cb20-3"><a href="#cb20-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    prediction_grid,</span>
<span id="cb20-4"><a href="#cb20-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    environmental_columns,</span>
<span id="cb20-5"><a href="#cb20-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    method,</span>
<span id="cb20-6"><a href="#cb20-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    k<span class="op">=</span>K_NEIGHBORS,</span>
<span id="cb20-7"><a href="#cb20-7" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>):</span>
<span id="cb20-8"><a href="#cb20-8" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    </span>
<span id="cb20-9"><a href="#cb20-9" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="co"># Environmental predictors</span></span>
<span id="cb20-10"><a href="#cb20-10" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    X_train <span class="op">=</span> data[environmental_columns].reset_index(drop<span class="op">=</span><span class="va">True</span>).copy()</span>
<span id="cb20-11"><a href="#cb20-11" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    X_grid <span class="op">=</span> prediction_grid[environmental_columns].reset_index(drop<span class="op">=</span><span class="va">True</span>).copy()</span>
<span id="cb20-12"><a href="#cb20-12" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb20-13"><a href="#cb20-13" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="cf">if</span> method <span class="op">==</span> <span class="st">"RFSI"</span>:</span>
<span id="cb20-14"><a href="#cb20-14" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb20-15"><a href="#cb20-15" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        <span class="co"># Neighbour predictors for training locations.</span></span>
<span id="cb20-16"><a href="#cb20-16" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        <span class="co"># Each training sample is excluded from its own neighbour list.</span></span>
<span id="cb20-17"><a href="#cb20-17" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        train_nn <span class="op">=</span> nearest_observation_features(</span>
<span id="cb20-18"><a href="#cb20-18" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            reference_xy<span class="op">=</span>data[[<span class="st">"x"</span>, <span class="st">"y"</span>]],</span>
<span id="cb20-19"><a href="#cb20-19" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            reference_z<span class="op">=</span>data[<span class="st">"zinc"</span>],</span>
<span id="cb20-20"><a href="#cb20-20" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            query_xy<span class="op">=</span>data[[<span class="st">"x"</span>, <span class="st">"y"</span>]],</span>
<span id="cb20-21"><a href="#cb20-21" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            k<span class="op">=</span>k,</span>
<span id="cb20-22"><a href="#cb20-22" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            exclude_self<span class="op">=</span><span class="va">True</span>,</span>
<span id="cb20-23"><a href="#cb20-23" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        )</span>
<span id="cb20-24"><a href="#cb20-24" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb20-25"><a href="#cb20-25" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        <span class="co"># Neighbour predictors for prediction-grid cells.</span></span>
<span id="cb20-26"><a href="#cb20-26" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        <span class="co"># All observed Meuse samples can be used as reference observations.</span></span>
<span id="cb20-27"><a href="#cb20-27" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        grid_nn <span class="op">=</span> nearest_observation_features(</span>
<span id="cb20-28"><a href="#cb20-28" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            reference_xy<span class="op">=</span>data[[<span class="st">"x"</span>, <span class="st">"y"</span>]],</span>
<span id="cb20-29"><a href="#cb20-29" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            reference_z<span class="op">=</span>data[<span class="st">"zinc"</span>],</span>
<span id="cb20-30"><a href="#cb20-30" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            query_xy<span class="op">=</span>prediction_grid[[<span class="st">"x"</span>, <span class="st">"y"</span>]],</span>
<span id="cb20-31"><a href="#cb20-31" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            k<span class="op">=</span>k,</span>
<span id="cb20-32"><a href="#cb20-32" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            exclude_self<span class="op">=</span><span class="va">False</span>,</span>
<span id="cb20-33"><a href="#cb20-33" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        )</span>
<span id="cb20-34"><a href="#cb20-34" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb20-35"><a href="#cb20-35" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        X_train <span class="op">=</span> pd.concat(</span>
<span id="cb20-36"><a href="#cb20-36" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            [X_train, train_nn.reset_index(drop<span class="op">=</span><span class="va">True</span>)],</span>
<span id="cb20-37"><a href="#cb20-37" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            axis<span class="op">=</span><span class="dv">1</span>,</span>
<span id="cb20-38"><a href="#cb20-38" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        )</span>
<span id="cb20-39"><a href="#cb20-39" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb20-40"><a href="#cb20-40" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        X_grid <span class="op">=</span> pd.concat(</span>
<span id="cb20-41"><a href="#cb20-41" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            [X_grid, grid_nn.reset_index(drop<span class="op">=</span><span class="va">True</span>)],</span>
<span id="cb20-42"><a href="#cb20-42" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            axis<span class="op">=</span><span class="dv">1</span>,</span>
<span id="cb20-43"><a href="#cb20-43" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        )</span>
<span id="cb20-44"><a href="#cb20-44" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb20-45"><a href="#cb20-45" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="cf">elif</span> method <span class="op">!=</span> <span class="st">"RF"</span>:</span>
<span id="cb20-46"><a href="#cb20-46" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        <span class="cf">raise</span> <span class="pp">ValueError</span>(<span class="st">"method must be 'RF' or 'RFSI'"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb20-47"><a href="#cb20-47" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb20-48"><a href="#cb20-48" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    model <span class="op">=</span> make_rf_pipeline(</span>
<span id="cb20-49"><a href="#cb20-49" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        feature_columns<span class="op">=</span>X_train.columns.tolist(),</span>
<span id="cb20-50"><a href="#cb20-50" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        random_state<span class="op">=</span>RANDOM_STATE,</span>
<span id="cb20-51"><a href="#cb20-51" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        n_trees<span class="op">=</span><span class="dv">1000</span>,</span>
<span id="cb20-52"><a href="#cb20-52" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    )</span>
<span id="cb20-53"><a href="#cb20-53" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb20-54"><a href="#cb20-54" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    model.fit(X_train, data[<span class="st">"zinc"</span>])</span>
<span id="cb20-55"><a href="#cb20-55" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb20-56"><a href="#cb20-56" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    prediction <span class="op">=</span> model.predict(X_grid)</span>
<span id="cb20-57"><a href="#cb20-57" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb20-58"><a href="#cb20-58" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="cf">return</span> model, prediction</span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>
</div>
<div id="44c259c8-f92b-4cfc-9abf-f7582b5e6445" class="cell" data-execution_count="17">
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode cell-code" id="cb21"><pre class="sourceCode python code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode python"><span id="cb21-1"><a href="#cb21-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>METHODS <span class="op">=</span> [<span class="st">"RF"</span>, <span class="st">"RFSI"</span>]</span>
<span id="cb21-2"><a href="#cb21-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb21-3"><a href="#cb21-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>final_models <span class="op">=</span> {}</span>
<span id="cb21-4"><a href="#cb21-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>map_predictions <span class="op">=</span> {}</span>
<span id="cb21-5"><a href="#cb21-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb21-6"><a href="#cb21-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">for</span> scenario, environmental_columns <span class="kw">in</span> SCENARIOS.items():</span>
<span id="cb21-7"><a href="#cb21-7" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb21-8"><a href="#cb21-8" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    final_models[scenario] <span class="op">=</span> {}</span>
<span id="cb21-9"><a href="#cb21-9" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    map_predictions[scenario] <span class="op">=</span> {}</span>
<span id="cb21-10"><a href="#cb21-10" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb21-11"><a href="#cb21-11" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="cf">for</span> method <span class="kw">in</span> METHODS:</span>
<span id="cb21-12"><a href="#cb21-12" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb21-13"><a href="#cb21-13" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        <span class="bu">print</span>(</span>
<span id="cb21-14"><a href="#cb21-14" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            <span class="ss">f"Fitting </span><span class="sc">{</span>method<span class="sc">}</span><span class="ss"> for </span><span class="sc">{</span>scenario<span class="sc">}</span><span class="ss">: "</span></span>
<span id="cb21-15"><a href="#cb21-15" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            <span class="ss">f"</span><span class="sc">{</span>environmental_columns<span class="sc">}</span><span class="ss">"</span></span>
<span id="cb21-16"><a href="#cb21-16" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        )</span>
<span id="cb21-17"><a href="#cb21-17" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb21-18"><a href="#cb21-18" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        model, prediction <span class="op">=</span> fit_full_and_predict_grid(</span>
<span id="cb21-19"><a href="#cb21-19" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            data<span class="op">=</span>meuse,</span>
<span id="cb21-20"><a href="#cb21-20" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            prediction_grid<span class="op">=</span>grid,</span>
<span id="cb21-21"><a href="#cb21-21" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            environmental_columns<span class="op">=</span>environmental_columns,</span>
<span id="cb21-22"><a href="#cb21-22" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            method<span class="op">=</span>method,</span>
<span id="cb21-23"><a href="#cb21-23" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            k<span class="op">=</span>K_NEIGHBORS,</span>
<span id="cb21-24"><a href="#cb21-24" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        )</span>
<span id="cb21-25"><a href="#cb21-25" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb21-26"><a href="#cb21-26" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        final_models[scenario][method] <span class="op">=</span> model</span>
<span id="cb21-27"><a href="#cb21-27" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        map_predictions[scenario][method] <span class="op">=</span> prediction</span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>

<pre><code>Fitting RF for distance_only: ['dist']
Fitting RFSI for distance_only: ['dist']
Fitting RF for distance_flood: ['dist', 'ffreq']
Fitting RFSI for distance_flood: ['dist', 'ffreq']
Fitting RF for distance_soil: ['dist', 'soil']
Fitting RFSI for distance_soil: ['dist', 'soil']
Fitting RF for distance_flood_soil: ['dist', 'ffreq', 'soil']

<div id="41650c17-4767-46b5-92d3-d18fd58b54de" class="cell" data-execution_count="18">
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode cell-code" id="cb23"><pre class="sourceCode python code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode python"><span id="cb23-1"><a href="#cb23-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>map_frame <span class="op">=</span> grid[[<span class="st">"x"</span>, <span class="st">"y"</span>]].copy()</span>
<span id="cb23-2"><a href="#cb23-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb23-3"><a href="#cb23-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">for</span> scenario <span class="kw">in</span> SCENARIOS:</span>
<span id="cb23-4"><a href="#cb23-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb23-5"><a href="#cb23-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    rf_column <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ss">f"</span><span class="sc">{</span>scenario<span class="sc">}</span><span class="ss">_RF"</span></span>
<span id="cb23-6"><a href="#cb23-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    rfsi_column <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ss">f"</span><span class="sc">{</span>scenario<span class="sc">}</span><span class="ss">_RFSI"</span></span>
<span id="cb23-7"><a href="#cb23-7" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    difference_column <span class="op">=</span> <span class="ss">f"</span><span class="sc">{</span>scenario<span class="sc">}</span><span class="ss">_RFSI_minus_RF"</span></span>
<span id="cb23-8"><a href="#cb23-8" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb23-9"><a href="#cb23-9" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    map_frame[rf_column] <span class="op">=</span> map_predictions[scenario][<span class="st">"RF"</span>]</span>
<span id="cb23-10"><a href="#cb23-10" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    map_frame[rfsi_column] <span class="op">=</span> map_predictions[scenario][<span class="st">"RFSI"</span>]</span>
<span id="cb23-11"><a href="#cb23-11" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb23-12"><a href="#cb23-12" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    map_frame[difference_column] <span class="op">=</span> (</span>
<span id="cb23-13"><a href="#cb23-13" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        map_frame[rfsi_column]</span>
<span id="cb23-14"><a href="#cb23-14" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        <span class="op">-</span> map_frame[rf_column]</span>
<span id="cb23-15"><a href="#cb23-15" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    )</span>
<span id="cb23-16"><a href="#cb23-16" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb23-17"><a href="#cb23-17" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>display(map_frame.head())</span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>

<div id="f6c8dd87-d671-4dc5-87a0-523889554dfa" class="cell" data-execution_count="19">
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode cell-code" id="cb24"><pre class="sourceCode python code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode python"><span id="cb24-1"><a href="#cb24-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>scenario_labels <span class="op">=</span> {</span>
<span id="cb24-2"><a href="#cb24-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="st">"distance_only"</span>: <span class="st">"dist"</span>,</span>
<span id="cb24-3"><a href="#cb24-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="st">"distance_flood"</span>: <span class="st">"dist + ffreq"</span>,</span>
<span id="cb24-4"><a href="#cb24-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="st">"distance_soil"</span>: <span class="st">"dist + soil"</span>,</span>
<span id="cb24-5"><a href="#cb24-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="st">"distance_flood_soil"</span>: <span class="st">"dist + ffreq + soil"</span>,</span>
<span id="cb24-6"><a href="#cb24-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>}</span>
<span id="cb24-7"><a href="#cb24-7" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb24-8"><a href="#cb24-8" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>n_scenarios <span class="op">=</span> <span class="bu">len</span>(SCENARIOS)</span>
<span id="cb24-9"><a href="#cb24-9" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb24-10"><a href="#cb24-10" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>fig, axes <span class="op">=</span> plt.subplots(</span>
<span id="cb24-11"><a href="#cb24-11" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    nrows<span class="op">=</span>n_scenarios,</span>
<span id="cb24-12"><a href="#cb24-12" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    ncols<span class="op">=</span><span class="dv">3</span>,</span>
<span id="cb24-13"><a href="#cb24-13" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    figsize<span class="op">=</span>(<span class="dv">18</span>, <span class="fl">5.5</span> <span class="op">*</span> n_scenarios),</span>
<span id="cb24-14"><a href="#cb24-14" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    sharex<span class="op">=</span><span class="va">True</span>,</span>
<span id="cb24-15"><a href="#cb24-15" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    sharey<span class="op">=</span><span class="va">True</span>,</span>
<span id="cb24-16"><a href="#cb24-16" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    layout<span class="op">=</span><span class="st">"constrained"</span>,</span>
<span id="cb24-17"><a href="#cb24-17" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    squeeze<span class="op">=</span><span class="va">False</span>,</span>
<span id="cb24-18"><a href="#cb24-18" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>)</span>
<span id="cb24-19"><a href="#cb24-19" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb24-20"><a href="#cb24-20" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># Remove the grid lines created by seaborn's "whitegrid" style</span></span>
<span id="cb24-21"><a href="#cb24-21" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">for</span> ax <span class="kw">in</span> axes.flat:</span>
<span id="cb24-22"><a href="#cb24-22" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    ax.grid(<span class="va">False</span>)</span>
<span id="cb24-23"><a href="#cb24-23" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    ax.set_facecolor(<span class="st">"white"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb24-24"><a href="#cb24-24" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb24-25"><a href="#cb24-25" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb24-26"><a href="#cb24-26" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># ---------------------------------------------------------</span></span>
<span id="cb24-27"><a href="#cb24-27" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># Common colour scale for all RF and RFSI predictions</span></span>
<span id="cb24-28"><a href="#cb24-28" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># ---------------------------------------------------------</span></span>
<span id="cb24-29"><a href="#cb24-29" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb24-30"><a href="#cb24-30" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>all_predictions <span class="op">=</span> np.concatenate([</span>
<span id="cb24-31"><a href="#cb24-31" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    map_predictions[scenario][method]</span>
<span id="cb24-32"><a href="#cb24-32" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="cf">for</span> scenario <span class="kw">in</span> SCENARIOS</span>
<span id="cb24-33"><a href="#cb24-33" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="cf">for</span> method <span class="kw">in</span> [<span class="st">"RF"</span>, <span class="st">"RFSI"</span>]</span>
<span id="cb24-34"><a href="#cb24-34" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>])</span>
<span id="cb24-35"><a href="#cb24-35" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb24-36"><a href="#cb24-36" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>prediction_min <span class="op">=</span> all_predictions.<span class="bu">min</span>()</span>
<span id="cb24-37"><a href="#cb24-37" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>prediction_max <span class="op">=</span> all_predictions.<span class="bu">max</span>()</span>
<span id="cb24-38"><a href="#cb24-38" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb24-39"><a href="#cb24-39" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb24-40"><a href="#cb24-40" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># ---------------------------------------------------------</span></span>
<span id="cb24-41"><a href="#cb24-41" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># Common symmetric scale for all RFSI − RF maps</span></span>
<span id="cb24-42"><a href="#cb24-42" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># ---------------------------------------------------------</span></span>
<span id="cb24-43"><a href="#cb24-43" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb24-44"><a href="#cb24-44" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>all_differences <span class="op">=</span> np.concatenate([</span>
<span id="cb24-45"><a href="#cb24-45" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    map_predictions[scenario][<span class="st">"RFSI"</span>]</span>
<span id="cb24-46"><a href="#cb24-46" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="op">-</span> map_predictions[scenario][<span class="st">"RF"</span>]</span>
<span id="cb24-47"><a href="#cb24-47" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="cf">for</span> scenario <span class="kw">in</span> SCENARIOS</span>
<span id="cb24-48"><a href="#cb24-48" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>])</span>
<span id="cb24-49"><a href="#cb24-49" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb24-50"><a href="#cb24-50" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>difference_limit <span class="op">=</span> np.<span class="bu">abs</span>(all_differences).<span class="bu">max</span>()</span>
<span id="cb24-51"><a href="#cb24-51" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb24-52"><a href="#cb24-52" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb24-53"><a href="#cb24-53" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># ---------------------------------------------------------</span></span>
<span id="cb24-54"><a href="#cb24-54" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># Plot every scenario</span></span>
<span id="cb24-55"><a href="#cb24-55" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># ---------------------------------------------------------</span></span>
<span id="cb24-56"><a href="#cb24-56" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb24-57"><a href="#cb24-57" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">for</span> row, scenario <span class="kw">in</span> <span class="bu">enumerate</span>(SCENARIOS):</span>
<span id="cb24-58"><a href="#cb24-58" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb24-59"><a href="#cb24-59" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    scenario_label <span class="op">=</span> scenario_labels.get(scenario, scenario)</span>
<span id="cb24-60"><a href="#cb24-60" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb24-61"><a href="#cb24-61" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    rf_prediction <span class="op">=</span> map_predictions[scenario][<span class="st">"RF"</span>]</span>
<span id="cb24-62"><a href="#cb24-62" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    rfsi_prediction <span class="op">=</span> map_predictions[scenario][<span class="st">"RFSI"</span>]</span>
<span id="cb24-63"><a href="#cb24-63" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    difference <span class="op">=</span> rfsi_prediction <span class="op">-</span> rf_prediction</span>
<span id="cb24-64"><a href="#cb24-64" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb24-65"><a href="#cb24-65" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="co"># RF prediction</span></span>
<span id="cb24-66"><a href="#cb24-66" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    sc_prediction <span class="op">=</span> axes[row, <span class="dv">0</span>].scatter(</span>
<span id="cb24-67"><a href="#cb24-67" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        map_frame[<span class="st">"x"</span>],</span>
<span id="cb24-68"><a href="#cb24-68" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        map_frame[<span class="st">"y"</span>],</span>
<span id="cb24-69"><a href="#cb24-69" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        c<span class="op">=</span>rf_prediction,</span>
<span id="cb24-70"><a href="#cb24-70" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        cmap<span class="op">=</span><span class="st">"viridis"</span>,</span>
<span id="cb24-71"><a href="#cb24-71" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        vmin<span class="op">=</span>prediction_min,</span>
<span id="cb24-72"><a href="#cb24-72" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        vmax<span class="op">=</span>prediction_max,</span>
<span id="cb24-73"><a href="#cb24-73" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        marker<span class="op">=</span><span class="st">"s"</span>,</span>
<span id="cb24-74"><a href="#cb24-74" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        s<span class="op">=</span><span class="dv">12</span>,</span>
<span id="cb24-75"><a href="#cb24-75" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        linewidths<span class="op">=</span><span class="dv">0</span>,</span>
<span id="cb24-76"><a href="#cb24-76" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        edgecolors<span class="op">=</span><span class="st">"none"</span>,</span>
<span id="cb24-77"><a href="#cb24-77" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        antialiaseds<span class="op">=</span><span class="va">False</span>,</span>
<span id="cb24-78"><a href="#cb24-78" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        rasterized<span class="op">=</span><span class="va">True</span>,</span>
<span id="cb24-79"><a href="#cb24-79" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        zorder<span class="op">=</span><span class="dv">1</span>,</span>
<span id="cb24-80"><a href="#cb24-80" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    )</span>
<span id="cb24-81"><a href="#cb24-81" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb24-82"><a href="#cb24-82" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="co"># RFSI prediction</span></span>
<span id="cb24-83"><a href="#cb24-83" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    axes[row, <span class="dv">1</span>].scatter(</span>
<span id="cb24-84"><a href="#cb24-84" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        map_frame[<span class="st">"x"</span>],</span>
<span id="cb24-85"><a href="#cb24-85" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        map_frame[<span class="st">"y"</span>],</span>

<section id="report" class="level1">
<h1>REPORT</h1>
<section id="is-there-a-difference-in-accuracy-between-rf-and-rfsi" class="level2">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="is-there-a-difference-in-accuracy-between-rf-and-rfsi">1. Is there a difference in accuracy between RF and RFSI?</h2>
<p><strong>RFSI produced lower RMSE and MAE than RF in all four scenarios</strong>, but the magnitude of the improvement depended strongly on the environmental covariates included in the model.</p>
<table class="caption-top table">
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 14%">
<col style="width: 40%">
<col style="width: 24%">
<col style="width: 20%">
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr class="header">
<th>Scenario</th>
<th style="text-align: right;">RMSE improvement with RFSI</th>
<th style="text-align: right;">MAE improvement</th>
<th style="text-align: right;">Change in R²</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="odd">
<td>Distance only</td>
<td style="text-align: right;"><strong>25.129 mg/kg</strong> (9.63%)</td>
<td style="text-align: right;">24.906 mg/kg</td>
<td style="text-align: right;">+0.093</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td>Distance + flood frequency</td>
<td style="text-align: right;"><strong>7.976 mg/kg</strong> (3.44%)</td>
<td style="text-align: right;">10.993 mg/kg</td>
<td style="text-align: right;">+0.027</td>
</tr>
<tr class="odd">
<td>Distance + soil type</td>
<td style="text-align: right;"><strong>11.926 mg/kg</strong> (4.81%)</td>
<td style="text-align: right;">10.798 mg/kg</td>
<td style="text-align: right;">+0.043</td>
</tr>
<tr class="even">
<td>Distance + flood frequency + soil</td>
<td style="text-align: right;"><strong>0.999 mg/kg</strong> (0.45%)</td>
<td style="text-align: right;">7.382 mg/kg</td>
<td style="text-align: right;">+0.003</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p>With distance to the river as the only environmental predictor, RFSI clearly outperformed RF. Adding either flood frequency or soil type reduced this advantage, although RFSI still improved RMSE, MAE and R2. With both flood frequency and soil type included, RF and RFSI had practically identical RMSE and R2.</p>
<p>CCC did not show a consistent RFSI advantage. RFSI reduced individual prediction errors but did not necessarily improve overall agreement in the mean and variance of predictions.</p>
<p>The mean errors were close to zero for all models. RF showed slight underprediction, whereas RFSI showed slight overprediction.</p>
<p>Therefore, <strong>RFSI cannot be considered universally more accurate than RF</strong>. It provided a meaningful advantage when environmental information was limited, but the advantage largely disappeared after relevant floodplain covariates were included.</p>
</section>
<section id="does-adding-flood-frequency-and-soil-type-improve-prediction" class="level2">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="does-adding-flood-frequency-and-soil-type-improve-prediction">2. Does adding flood frequency and soil type improve prediction?</h2>
<p>Flood frequency improved both methods. Soil type alone improved RF but did not improve RFSI relative to the distance-only scenario. The combined flood-frequency and soil model produced the lowest RMSE for both methods. Overall, environmental covariates improved ordinary RF more strongly and reduced the additional benefit of RFSI.</p>
</section>
<section id="conclusion" class="level2">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="conclusion">Conclusion</h2>
<p>The paired spatial-block bootstrap intervals crossed zero in all four scenarios, so the primary split does not provide conclusive 95% evidence that either method is more accurate. Nevertheless, the strongest support for an RFSI improvement occurred in the distance-only scenario (87.0% of bootstrap resamples), followed by distance + soil (71.3%). The repeated and spatial validation analyses below assess how stable these findings are under other data partitions.</p>
</section>
</section>
<section id="additional-sensitivity-analyses" class="level1">
<h1>ADDITIONAL SENSITIVITY ANALYSES</h1>
<section id="sensitivity-to-the-number-of-neighbours" class="level2">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="sensitivity-to-the-number-of-neighbours">Sensitivity to the number of neighbours</h2>
<p>The OpenGeoHub example uses 10 neighbours; the original RFSI paper used 25 in its case studies and treated neighbour count as a tunable parameter. Too small <span class="math inline">\(k\)</span> may make predictions unstable; too large <span class="math inline">\(k\)</span> may dilute local information and add correlated predictors.</p>
<p>The following is an <strong>exploratory sensitivity analysis</strong> using the same outer folds. Do not select the best <span class="math inline">\(k\)</span> here and then report its minimum RMSE as unbiased performance: that would tune on the evaluation folds. If formal tuning is required, <span class="math inline">\(k\)</span> must be chosen inside an inner CV loop nested within each outer fold.</p>
<div id="19c9afdf-bd8b-4492-bbb1-b3763141c737" class="cell" data-execution_count="20">
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode cell-code" id="cb25"><pre class="sourceCode python code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode python"><span id="cb25-1"><a href="#cb25-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>K_VALUES <span class="op">=</span> [<span class="dv">3</span>, <span class="dv">5</span>, <span class="dv">10</span>, <span class="dv">15</span>, <span class="dv">25</span>]</span>
<span id="cb25-2"><a href="#cb25-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>k_rows <span class="op">=</span> []</span>
<span id="cb25-3"><a href="#cb25-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb25-4"><a href="#cb25-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">for</span> scenario, columns <span class="kw">in</span> SCENARIOS.items():</span>
<span id="cb25-5"><a href="#cb25-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="cf">for</span> k <span class="kw">in</span> K_VALUES:</span>
<span id="cb25-6"><a href="#cb25-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        <span class="bu">print</span>(<span class="ss">f"k sensitivity: </span><span class="sc">{</span>scenario<span class="sc">}</span><span class="ss">, k=</span><span class="sc">{</span>k<span class="sc">}</span><span class="ss">"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb25-7"><a href="#cb25-7" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        result <span class="op">=</span> cross_validate_method(</span>
<span id="cb25-8"><a href="#cb25-8" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            meuse, primary_folds, columns, <span class="st">"RFSI"</span>, k<span class="op">=</span>k, n_trees<span class="op">=</span><span class="dv">400</span></span>
<span id="cb25-9"><a href="#cb25-9" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        )</span>
<span id="cb25-10"><a href="#cb25-10" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        k_rows.append({</span>
<span id="cb25-11"><a href="#cb25-11" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            <span class="st">"scenario"</span>: scenario,</span>
<span id="cb25-12"><a href="#cb25-12" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            <span class="st">"k"</span>: k,</span>
<span id="cb25-13"><a href="#cb25-13" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            <span class="op">**</span>regression_metrics(result[<span class="st">"observed"</span>], result[<span class="st">"predicted"</span>]),</span>
<span id="cb25-14"><a href="#cb25-14" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        })</span>
<span id="cb25-15"><a href="#cb25-15" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb25-16"><a href="#cb25-16" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>k_sensitivity <span class="op">=</span> pd.DataFrame(k_rows)</span>
<span id="cb25-17"><a href="#cb25-17" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>display(k_sensitivity.<span class="bu">round</span>(<span class="dv">3</span>))</span>
<span id="cb25-18"><a href="#cb25-18" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb25-19"><a href="#cb25-19" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>fig, ax <span class="op">=</span> plt.subplots(figsize<span class="op">=</span>(<span class="dv">8</span>, <span class="fl">4.5</span>))</span>
<span id="cb25-20"><a href="#cb25-20" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>sns.lineplot(data<span class="op">=</span>k_sensitivity, x<span class="op">=</span><span class="st">"k"</span>, y<span class="op">=</span><span class="st">"RMSE"</span>, hue<span class="op">=</span><span class="st">"scenario"</span>, marker<span class="op">=</span><span class="st">"o"</span>, ax<span class="op">=</span>ax)</span>
<span id="cb25-21"><a href="#cb25-21" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>ax.set_ylabel(<span class="st">"OOF RMSE (mg kg$^{-1}$)"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb25-22"><a href="#cb25-22" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>ax.set_title(<span class="st">"RFSI sensitivity to neighbour count"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb25-23"><a href="#cb25-23" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>plt.tight_layout()</span>
<span id="cb25-24"><a href="#cb25-24" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>plt.show()</span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>

<section id="repeated-5-fold-sensitivity" class="level2">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="repeated-5-fold-sensitivity">Repeated 5-fold sensitivity</h2>
<p>A single 5-fold split of only 155 observations can be seed-sensitive. Repeating shuffled 5-fold CV checks whether the direction and approximate size of the RFSI effect are stable across partitions. Repetitions are not independent experiments, so their percentile interval is a stability summary rather than a classical confidence interval.</p>
<div id="69b4d6f9-7607-4932-a514-a192a07b7ae6" class="cell" data-execution_count="21">
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode cell-code" id="cb27"><pre class="sourceCode python code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode python"><span id="cb27-1"><a href="#cb27-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>RUN_REPEATED_CV <span class="op">=</span> <span class="va">True</span></span>
<span id="cb27-2"><a href="#cb27-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>N_REPEATS <span class="op">=</span> <span class="dv">10</span></span>
<span id="cb27-3"><a href="#cb27-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb27-4"><a href="#cb27-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>repeated_rows <span class="op">=</span> []</span>
<span id="cb27-5"><a href="#cb27-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">if</span> RUN_REPEATED_CV:</span>
<span id="cb27-6"><a href="#cb27-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="cf">for</span> repeat <span class="kw">in</span> <span class="bu">range</span>(N_REPEATS):</span>
<span id="cb27-7"><a href="#cb27-7" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        folds <span class="op">=</span> make_random_folds(meuse, random_state<span class="op">=</span>RANDOM_STATE <span class="op">+</span> repeat)</span>
<span id="cb27-8"><a href="#cb27-8" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        <span class="cf">for</span> scenario, columns <span class="kw">in</span> SCENARIOS.items():</span>
<span id="cb27-9"><a href="#cb27-9" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            repeat_metrics <span class="op">=</span> {}</span>
<span id="cb27-10"><a href="#cb27-10" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            <span class="cf">for</span> method <span class="kw">in</span> [<span class="st">"RF"</span>, <span class="st">"RFSI"</span>]:</span>
<span id="cb27-11"><a href="#cb27-11" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>                result <span class="op">=</span> cross_validate_method(</span>
<span id="cb27-12"><a href="#cb27-12" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>                    meuse, folds, columns, method, k<span class="op">=</span>K_NEIGHBORS, n_trees<span class="op">=</span><span class="dv">300</span></span>
<span id="cb27-13"><a href="#cb27-13" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>                )</span>
<span id="cb27-14"><a href="#cb27-14" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>                repeat_metrics[method] <span class="op">=</span> regression_metrics(</span>
<span id="cb27-15"><a href="#cb27-15" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>                    result[<span class="st">"observed"</span>], result[<span class="st">"predicted"</span>]</span>
<span id="cb27-16"><a href="#cb27-16" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>                )</span>
<span id="cb27-17"><a href="#cb27-17" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            repeated_rows.append({</span>
<span id="cb27-18"><a href="#cb27-18" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>                <span class="st">"repeat"</span>: repeat <span class="op">+</span> <span class="dv">1</span>,</span>
<span id="cb27-19"><a href="#cb27-19" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>                <span class="st">"scenario"</span>: scenario,</span>
<span id="cb27-20"><a href="#cb27-20" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>                <span class="st">"delta_RMSE"</span>: repeat_metrics[<span class="st">"RFSI"</span>][<span class="st">"RMSE"</span>] <span class="op">-</span> repeat_metrics[<span class="st">"RF"</span>][<span class="st">"RMSE"</span>],</span>
<span id="cb27-21"><a href="#cb27-21" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>                <span class="st">"delta_MAE"</span>: repeat_metrics[<span class="st">"RFSI"</span>][<span class="st">"MAE"</span>] <span class="op">-</span> repeat_metrics[<span class="st">"RF"</span>][<span class="st">"MAE"</span>],</span>
<span id="cb27-22"><a href="#cb27-22" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>                <span class="st">"delta_R2"</span>: repeat_metrics[<span class="st">"RFSI"</span>][<span class="st">"R2"</span>] <span class="op">-</span> repeat_metrics[<span class="st">"RF"</span>][<span class="st">"R2"</span>],</span>
<span id="cb27-23"><a href="#cb27-23" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            })</span>
<span id="cb27-24"><a href="#cb27-24" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb27-25"><a href="#cb27-25" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    repeated_results <span class="op">=</span> pd.DataFrame(repeated_rows)</span>
<span id="cb27-26"><a href="#cb27-26" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    display(repeated_results.groupby(<span class="st">"scenario"</span>)[[<span class="st">"delta_RMSE"</span>, <span class="st">"delta_MAE"</span>, <span class="st">"delta_R2"</span>]]</span>
<span id="cb27-27"><a href="#cb27-27" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            .agg([<span class="st">"mean"</span>, <span class="st">"std"</span>, <span class="st">"min"</span>, <span class="st">"max"</span>]).<span class="bu">round</span>(<span class="dv">3</span>))</span>
<span id="cb27-28"><a href="#cb27-28" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    sns.boxplot(data<span class="op">=</span>repeated_results, x<span class="op">=</span><span class="st">"scenario"</span>, y<span class="op">=</span><span class="st">"delta_RMSE"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb27-29"><a href="#cb27-29" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    plt.axhline(<span class="dv">0</span>, color<span class="op">=</span><span class="st">"black"</span>, linestyle<span class="op">=</span><span class="st">"--"</span>, linewidth<span class="op">=</span><span class="dv">1</span>)</span>
<span id="cb27-30"><a href="#cb27-30" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    plt.ylabel(<span class="st">"ΔRMSE = RFSI − RF"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb27-31"><a href="#cb27-31" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    plt.title(<span class="st">"Sensitivity across repeated 5-fold partitions"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb27-32"><a href="#cb27-32" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    plt.show()</span>
<span id="cb27-33"><a href="#cb27-33" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">else</span>:</span>
<span id="cb27-34"><a href="#cb27-34" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="bu">print</span>(<span class="st">"Repeated CV skipped. Set RUN_REPEATED_CV=True to run it."</span>)</span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>

<section id="spatially-clustered-5-fold-validation" class="level2">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="spatially-clustered-5-fold-validation">Spatially clustered 5-fold validation</h2>
<p>Random CV answers: <em>How well can I interpolate unsampled points located among the remaining sample network?</em> A spatial-cluster test asks: <em>How well can I predict a geographically withheld subregion?</em> These are different operational tasks.</p>
<p>RFSI normally benefits from nearby observed values. In a held-out cluster its nearest reference observations are farther away, so performance may deteriorate sharply. This is not a contradiction; it reveals that interpolation accuracy does not equal spatial extrapolation accuracy.</p>
<p>K-means clusters are a transparent demonstration, not an optimal spatial blocking algorithm.</p>
<div id="278df23d-632f-4559-b6ea-bda62e4fe73e" class="cell" data-execution_count="22">
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode cell-code" id="cb28"><pre class="sourceCode python code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode python"><span id="cb28-1"><a href="#cb28-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>xy <span class="op">=</span> meuse[[<span class="st">"x"</span>, <span class="st">"y"</span>]].to_numpy(dtype<span class="op">=</span><span class="bu">float</span>)</span>
<span id="cb28-2"><a href="#cb28-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>xy_scaled <span class="op">=</span> (xy <span class="op">-</span> xy.mean(axis<span class="op">=</span><span class="dv">0</span>)) <span class="op">/</span> xy.std(axis<span class="op">=</span><span class="dv">0</span>)</span>
<span id="cb28-3"><a href="#cb28-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>cluster_id <span class="op">=</span> KMeans(n_clusters<span class="op">=</span><span class="dv">5</span>, n_init<span class="op">=</span><span class="dv">50</span>, random_state<span class="op">=</span>RANDOM_STATE).fit_predict(xy_scaled)</span>
<span id="cb28-4"><a href="#cb28-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb28-5"><a href="#cb28-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>spatial_folds <span class="op">=</span> []</span>
<span id="cb28-6"><a href="#cb28-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>all_index <span class="op">=</span> np.arange(<span class="bu">len</span>(meuse))</span>
<span id="cb28-7"><a href="#cb28-7" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">for</span> cluster <span class="kw">in</span> np.unique(cluster_id):</span>
<span id="cb28-8"><a href="#cb28-8" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    test_index <span class="op">=</span> all_index[cluster_id <span class="op">==</span> cluster]</span>
<span id="cb28-9"><a href="#cb28-9" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    train_index <span class="op">=</span> all_index[cluster_id <span class="op">!=</span> cluster]</span>
<span id="cb28-10"><a href="#cb28-10" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    spatial_folds.append((train_index, test_index))</span>
<span id="cb28-11"><a href="#cb28-11" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb28-12"><a href="#cb28-12" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>fig, ax <span class="op">=</span> plt.subplots(figsize<span class="op">=</span>(<span class="dv">6</span>, <span class="dv">7</span>))</span>
<span id="cb28-13"><a href="#cb28-13" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>ax.scatter(meuse[<span class="st">"x"</span>], meuse[<span class="st">"y"</span>], c<span class="op">=</span>cluster_id, cmap<span class="op">=</span><span class="st">"tab10"</span>, s<span class="op">=</span><span class="dv">55</span>)</span>
<span id="cb28-14"><a href="#cb28-14" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>ax.set_aspect(<span class="st">"equal"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb28-15"><a href="#cb28-15" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>ax.set_title(<span class="st">"Five spatially clustered folds"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb28-16"><a href="#cb28-16" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>ax.set_xlabel(<span class="st">"Easting (m)"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb28-17"><a href="#cb28-17" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>ax.set_ylabel(<span class="st">"Northing (m)"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb28-18"><a href="#cb28-18" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>plt.show()</span>
<span id="cb28-19"><a href="#cb28-19" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb28-20"><a href="#cb28-20" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>spatial_rows <span class="op">=</span> []</span>
<span id="cb28-21"><a href="#cb28-21" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">for</span> scenario, columns <span class="kw">in</span> SCENARIOS.items():</span>
<span id="cb28-22"><a href="#cb28-22" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="cf">for</span> method <span class="kw">in</span> [<span class="st">"RF"</span>, <span class="st">"RFSI"</span>]:</span>
<span id="cb28-23"><a href="#cb28-23" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        result <span class="op">=</span> cross_validate_method(</span>
<span id="cb28-24"><a href="#cb28-24" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            meuse, spatial_folds, columns, method, k<span class="op">=</span>K_NEIGHBORS, n_trees<span class="op">=</span><span class="dv">500</span></span>

<section id="log-target-sensitivity" class="level2">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="log-target-sensitivity">Log-target sensitivity</h2>
<p>Random Forest does not require a normal target, so a log transform is not mandatory. It changes the loss emphasis: fitting <code>log1p(zinc)</code> usually pays relatively more attention to proportional errors and low concentrations, while raw-scale RMSE prioritizes large absolute errors at high concentrations.</p>
<p>If used, fit the model on <code>log1p(zinc)</code>, predict on the log scale, and back-transform with <code>expm1</code>. A simple inverse transform estimates something closer to a conditional median on the raw scale and can be downward biased for a conditional mean. For that reason, raw-zinc results remain the main answer; a rigorous mean prediction would require a retransformation correction.</p>
<div id="98d4452a-a52d-4939-8caa-34588f5f98be" class="cell" data-execution_count="23">
<div class="code-copy-outer-scaffold"><div class="sourceCode cell-code" id="cb29"><pre class="sourceCode python code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode python"><span id="cb29-1"><a href="#cb29-1" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="kw">def</span> cross_validate_log_target(data, folds, environmental_columns, method, k<span class="op">=</span>K_NEIGHBORS):</span>
<span id="cb29-2"><a href="#cb29-2" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    oof <span class="op">=</span> np.full(<span class="bu">len</span>(data), np.nan)</span>
<span id="cb29-3"><a href="#cb29-3" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="cf">for</span> fold_number, (train_index, test_index) <span class="kw">in</span> <span class="bu">enumerate</span>(folds, start<span class="op">=</span><span class="dv">1</span>):</span>
<span id="cb29-4"><a href="#cb29-4" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        train <span class="op">=</span> data.iloc[train_index].reset_index(drop<span class="op">=</span><span class="va">True</span>)</span>
<span id="cb29-5"><a href="#cb29-5" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        test <span class="op">=</span> data.iloc[test_index].reset_index(drop<span class="op">=</span><span class="va">True</span>)</span>
<span id="cb29-6"><a href="#cb29-6" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        X_train, X_test <span class="op">=</span> fold_feature_tables(train, test, environmental_columns, method, k)</span>
<span id="cb29-7"><a href="#cb29-7" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        model <span class="op">=</span> make_rf_pipeline(</span>
<span id="cb29-8"><a href="#cb29-8" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            X_train.columns.tolist(), random_state<span class="op">=</span>RANDOM_STATE <span class="op">+</span> fold_number, n_trees<span class="op">=</span><span class="dv">500</span></span>
<span id="cb29-9"><a href="#cb29-9" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        )</span>
<span id="cb29-10"><a href="#cb29-10" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        model.fit(X_train, np.log1p(train[<span class="st">"zinc"</span>]))</span>
<span id="cb29-11"><a href="#cb29-11" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        oof[test_index] <span class="op">=</span> np.expm1(model.predict(X_test))</span>
<span id="cb29-12"><a href="#cb29-12" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="cf">return</span> oof</span>
<span id="cb29-13"><a href="#cb29-13" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb29-14"><a href="#cb29-14" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb29-15"><a href="#cb29-15" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>RUN_LOG_SENSITIVITY <span class="op">=</span> <span class="va">True</span></span>
<span id="cb29-16"><a href="#cb29-16" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">if</span> RUN_LOG_SENSITIVITY:</span>
<span id="cb29-17"><a href="#cb29-17" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    log_rows <span class="op">=</span> []</span>
<span id="cb29-18"><a href="#cb29-18" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="cf">for</span> scenario, columns <span class="kw">in</span> SCENARIOS.items():</span>
<span id="cb29-19"><a href="#cb29-19" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>        <span class="cf">for</span> method <span class="kw">in</span> [<span class="st">"RF"</span>, <span class="st">"RFSI"</span>]:</span>
<span id="cb29-20"><a href="#cb29-20" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            pred <span class="op">=</span> cross_validate_log_target(meuse, primary_folds, columns, method)</span>
<span id="cb29-21"><a href="#cb29-21" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            log_rows.append({</span>
<span id="cb29-22"><a href="#cb29-22" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>                <span class="st">"scenario"</span>: scenario,</span>
<span id="cb29-23"><a href="#cb29-23" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>                <span class="st">"method"</span>: method,</span>
<span id="cb29-24"><a href="#cb29-24" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>                <span class="op">**</span>regression_metrics(meuse[<span class="st">"zinc"</span>], pred),</span>
<span id="cb29-25"><a href="#cb29-25" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>            })</span>
<span id="cb29-26"><a href="#cb29-26" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    display(pd.DataFrame(log_rows).<span class="bu">round</span>(<span class="dv">3</span>))</span>
<span id="cb29-27"><a href="#cb29-27" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="cf">else</span>:</span>
<span id="cb29-28"><a href="#cb29-28" aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"></a>    <span class="bu">print</span>(<span class="st">"Log-target sensitivity skipped. Set RUN_LOG_SENSITIVITY=True to run it."</span>)</span></code></pre></div><button title="Copy to Clipboard" class="code-copy-button"><i class="bi"></i></button></div>

<section id="conclusion-after-applying-additional-sensitivity-analyses" class="level2">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="conclusion-after-applying-additional-sensitivity-analyses">Conclusion after applying additional sensitivity analyses</h2>
<p>The sensitivity analyses confirm that the RFSI advantage is most robust when environmental information is limited. RFSI outperformed RF in every repeated cross-validation run for both <code>distance_only</code> and <code>distance_soil</code>; the mean RMSE improvements were 19.268 and 13.108 mg/kg, respectively. The advantage was small and unstable for <code>distance_flood</code>, while the full <code>distance_flood_soil</code> scenario slightly favoured RF on average. Across all scenarios, RFSI generally performed best with 3–5 neighbours.</p>
<p><strong>Spatially clustered validation reversed the result in all four scenarios:</strong> RFSI performed substantially worse than RF and showed strong overprediction. Thus, RFSI is useful for interpolation within a well-sampled area but is less reliable for extrapolation into geographically withheld areas. Log-transforming zinc reduced MAE but introduced systematic underprediction and did not improve raw-scale RMSE consistently.</p>
<p>Overall, RF with relevant environmental covariates appears more robust, while RFSI provides its clearest benefit when covariate information is sparse and nearby observations are available.</p>
</section>

                note.children[0].remove();
              }
              const html = processXRef(null, note);
              instance.setContent(html);
            } 
          }).finally(() => {
            instance.enable();
            instance.show();
          });
        }
      }, function(instance) {
      });
    }
        let selectedAnnoteEl;
        const selectorForAnnotation = ( cell, annotation) => {
          let cellAttr = 'data-code-cell="' + cell + '"';
          let lineAttr = 'data-code-annotation="' +  annotation + '"';
          const selector = 'span[' + cellAttr + '][' + lineAttr + ']';
          return selector;
        }
        const selectCodeLines = (annoteEl) => {
          const doc = window.document;
          const targetCell = annoteEl.getAttribute("data-target-cell");
          const targetAnnotation = annoteEl.getAttribute("data-target-annotation");
          const annoteSpan = window.document.querySelector(selectorForAnnotation(targetCell, targetAnnotation));
          const lines = annoteSpan.getAttribute("data-code-lines").split(",");
          const lineIds = lines.map((line) => {
            return targetCell + "-" + line;
          })
          let top = null;
          let height = null;
          let parent = null;
          if (lineIds.length > 0) {
              //compute the position of the single el (top and bottom and make a div)
              const el = window.document.getElementById(lineIds[0]);
              top = el.offsetTop;
              height = el.offsetHeight;
              parent = el.parentElement.parentElement;
            if (lineIds.length > 1) {
              const lastEl = window.document.getElementById(lineIds[lineIds.length - 1]);
              const bottom = lastEl.offsetTop + lastEl.offsetHeight;
              height = bottom - top;
            }
            if (top !== null && height !== null && parent !== null) {
              // cook up a div (if necessary) and position it 
              let div = window.document.getElementById("code-annotation-line-highlight");
              if (div === null) {
                div = window.document.createElement("div");
                div.setAttribute("id", "code-annotation-line-highlight");
                div.style.position = 'absolute';
                parent.appendChild(div);
              }
              div.style.top = top - 2 + "px";
              div.style.height = height + 4 + "px";
              div.style.left = 0;
              let gutterDiv = window.document.getElementById("code-annotation-line-highlight-gutter");
              if (gutterDiv === null) {
                gutterDiv = window.document.createElement("div");
                gutterDiv.setAttribute("id", "code-annotation-line-highlight-gutter");
                gutterDiv.style.position = 'absolute';
                const codeCell = window.document.getElementById(targetCell);
                const gutter = codeCell.querySelector('.code-annotation-gutter');
                gutter.appendChild(gutterDiv);
              }
              gutterDiv.style.top = top - 2 + "px";
              gutterDiv.style.height = height + 4 + "px";
            }
            selectedAnnoteEl = annoteEl;
          }
        };
        const unselectCodeLines = () => {
          const elementsIds = ["code-annotation-line-highlight", "code-annotation-line-highlight-gutter"];
          elementsIds.forEach((elId) => {
            const div = window.document.getElementById(elId);
            if (div) {
              div.remove();
            }
          });
          selectedAnnoteEl = undefined;
        };
          // Handle positioning of the toggle
      window.addEventListener(
        "resize",
        throttle(() => {
          elRect = undefined;
          if (selectedAnnoteEl) {
            selectCodeLines(selectedAnnoteEl);
          }
        }, 10)
      );
      function throttle(fn, ms) {
      let throttle = false;
      let timer;
        return (...args) => {
          if(!throttle) { // first call gets through
              fn.apply(this, args);
              throttle = true;
          } else { // all the others get throttled
              if(timer) clearTimeout(timer); // cancel #2
              timer = setTimeout(() => {
                fn.apply(this, args);
                timer = throttle = false;
              }, ms);
          }
        };
      }
        // Attach click handler to the DT
        const annoteDls = window.document.querySelectorAll('dt[data-target-cell]');
        for (const annoteDlNode of annoteDls) {
          annoteDlNode.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
            const clickedEl = event.target;
            if (clickedEl !== selectedAnnoteEl) {
              unselectCodeLines();
              const activeEl = window.document.querySelector('dt[data-target-cell].code-annotation-active');
              if (activeEl) {
                activeEl.classList.remove('code-annotation-active');
              }
              selectCodeLines(clickedEl);
              clickedEl.classList.add('code-annotation-active');
            } else {
              // Unselect the line
              unselectCodeLines();
              clickedEl.classList.remove('code-annotation-active');
            }
          });
        }
    const findCites = (el) => {
      const parentEl = el.parentElement;
      if (parentEl) {
        const cites = parentEl.dataset.cites;
        if (cites) {
          return {
            el,
            cites: cites.split(' ')
          };
        } else {
          return findCites(el.parentElement)
        }
      } else {
        return undefined;
      }
    };
    var bibliorefs = window.document.querySelectorAll('a[role="doc-biblioref"]');
    for (var i=0; i<bibliorefs.length; i++) {
      const ref = bibliorefs[i];
      const citeInfo = findCites(ref);
      if (citeInfo) {
        tippyHover(citeInfo.el, function() {
          var popup = window.document.createElement('div');
          citeInfo.cites.forEach(function(cite) {
            var citeDiv = window.document.createElement('div');
            citeDiv.classList.add('hanging-indent');
            citeDiv.classList.add('csl-entry');
            var biblioDiv = window.document.getElementById('ref-' + cite);
            if (biblioDiv) {
              citeDiv.innerHTML = biblioDiv.innerHTML;
            }
            popup.appendChild(citeDiv);
          });
          return popup.innerHTML;
        });
      }
    }
  });
  </script>
